title: Databricks Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.

  

Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.

**Position Description**
------------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled Databricks Engineer with 4–6 years of experience in modern data engineering, distributed data processing, and cloud-based analytics. Azure Data Services (Good to Have)

* Exposure to Azure Data Lake (ADLS), Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL, Event Hub, Azure Functions, etc.

Data Engineering & Development

* Write high-quality, production-grade Python, PySpark, and SQL code.

Collaboration & Delivery

* Strong understanding of **Unity Catalog**, RBAC, and data governance practices.

* Understanding of distributed computing, performance tuning, and cost-efficient design.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, and basic DevOps practices.
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, ADF, etc.).
  

**Preferred Skills:**

Demonstrate flexibility and openness to bring creative solutions to address issues

title: GenAI Lead
description:

Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.

  

**Job Overview:**

We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled **Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer** to spearhead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered solutions. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers and data scientists to harness cutting-edge Generative AI technologies and implement them to solve complex business problems, enhance user experiences, and drive innovation. This role combines deep technical expertise, leadership, and a strong understanding of AI trends and tools.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Technical Leadership:
  + Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of Generative AI solutions.
  + Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and data scientists working on GenAI projects.
  + Stay updated with the latest trends, research, and advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Solution Development:
  + Architect, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art LLMs and generative AI models
  + Develop and optimize pipelines for prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and domain-specific fine-tuning.
  + Develop and deploy generative AI models, particularly focusing on ChatGPT, using Python on Azure or AWS Platform or .Net on Azure platform
  + Ensure scalability, performance, and security of AI solutions deployed in production.
  + Integration and Deployment:
* API Development:
  + Ability to define and deliver API access for GenAI services, facilitating integration with other systems and applications.
  + Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate GenAI solutions into enterprise applications and services.
  + Utilize cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP) to deploy and manage AI models and APIs.
  + Leverage MLOps practices for continuous model monitoring, retraining, and improvement.
* Data Strategy and Preparation:
  + Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality data acquisition, preprocessing, and augmentation for model training and fine-tuning.
  + Implement data governance and privacy practices in line with organizational policies.
* Innovation and Research:
  + Experiment with new generative AI techniques, such as multimodal AI, reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and active learning.
  + Evaluate and recommend AI frameworks, libraries, and platforms for project requirements.
* Stakeholder Collaboration:
  + Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and UX designers to define AI-powered product features and use cases.
  + Present technical concepts, project progress, and AI capabilities to non-technical audiences.

**Key Requirements**

* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services for AI/ML, such as Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Hands on experience in any of LLMs such as OpenAI's ChatGPT Models , Gemini, Llama 2 ,Claude 2 ,Grok
* Hands on experience in any of the agentic frameworks like LangChain, Semantic kernel, AutoGen, CrewAi
* Hands on experience using any of vector database like Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, Faiss
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF)
* Strong expertise in LLMs and generative AI frameworks like OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar platforms.
* Deep understanding of natural language processing (NLP) concepts, including tokenization, embeddings, and sequence-to-sequence models.
* Proficiency in Python and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
* Experience in CI/CD pipeline management and automation tools, particularly within the Azure DevOps environment. Knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools is also important
* Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution
* Minimum of 6 years of extensive full-time experience in Data Analysis, Statistics, Machine Learning, or Computer Science

* Certifications in AI/ML or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning).

title: Controls Engineer, Controls Deployment & Service India
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems that ensure the health of AWS data centers. Operating across Australia & New Zealand, India, North Asia, and Southeast Asia, APAC CDS manages 41 leased/owned sites and supports global follow-the-sun operations. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines: deployments (control systems in new data centers), projects (capital improvement works at live sites), and service (control systems at live sites), with additional specializations in colocated sites, systems engineering, controls fleet, program management, and coordination.  
  
As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.  
  
To be successful in this team, you will also have:
  

* Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
* Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
* Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed

  
Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Engineers deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade colocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Deployment of data center controls, on time, with effective management of vendors to ensure minimal defects at the point of Power and Facilities Hand-Off (PFHO)  

* Delivery of critical projects to upgrade data center automation
* Service and support provided to partner teams, providing diagnosis and resolution of Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), Large Scale Event (LSE), Critical Scale Event (CSE), and other operations impacting events
* Resolution of tasks within predefined Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Delivery of further initiatives to improve the efficiency of our data centers or our operations procedures

  
A day in the life  

* Join the cloud leader: AWS has the most proven operational and security expertise, and the business is innovating at a faster clip—especially in new areas such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Serverless Computing, and custom-designed processors and chips.
* Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
* Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon’s global presence.
* Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds.
* Continuous growth and learning: You may not be an expert in AWS when you join our company, but you will have support to become one. Benefit from direct access to industry-leading specialists, latest training materials, and courses to propel your career.

  
About the team  
About AWS  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment
* Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
* Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
* Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Head - Technology & AI | E-Commerce | AI Agents | Engineering & Automations
description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Ergode builds and scales digital-first businesses across global marketplaces.

We have made a clear strategic choice: **Technology, Artificial Intelligence and automation will sit at the core of how we scale revenue, improve margins and increase productivity.**

We are looking for a **hands-on Technology & AI leader** who can convert business problems into working, adopted systems — quickly.

This is not a traditional IT leadership role.

You will own the intersection of **business, engineering, AI, automation, data, integrations, infrastructure and security**. You will work directly with the CEO and business leaders to identify high-impact problems, decide what should be built internally versus externally, and ensure solutions move from idea production adoption measurable business outcome.

Some of our systems need modernization. Some need stronger ownership and architecture. Others need to be replaced or rebuilt. We would rather be transparent about that upfront.

We need someone who enjoys that challenge.

**What You Will Own**
=====================

**1. Technology Execution & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

You will create an execution culture where technology commitments translate into shipped outcomes.

You will:

* Run Technology on clear weekly priorities with an owner, deadline and measurable outcome for every major initiative.
* Establish strong engineering execution across product development, integrations, automation, infrastructure and AI.
* Track commitments through completion — not merely development activity.
* Identify blockers early and make fast build/buy/outsource decisions.
* Hold internal teams and external partners accountable for scope, timelines, quality and business outcomes.
* Build clear visibility from:

**Business Requirement**  **Development**  **Production**  **Adoption**  **Business Impact**

* Develop engineers and technology managers into stronger owners and future leaders.
* Create sufficient documentation, architecture standards and ownership so no critical system depends on one employee or vendor.

### **Success means:**

Leadership should never need to repeatedly ask, **“Where is this project stuck and who owns it?”**

**2. Business-First Technology Strategy**
=========================================

Technology exists to improve business outcomes.

You will:

* Deeply understand how Ergode makes money across marketplaces, brands and channels.
* Understand marketplace fees, margins, inventory, pricing, advertising, catalogue operations, fulfilment and customer experience.
* Own the Technology & AI roadmap based on impact on:
  + Revenue
  + Gross margin
  + Productivity
  + Operating cost
  + Speed
  + Customer/vendor experience
* Work directly with business heads to identify operational bottlenecks.
* Challenge processes that should be eliminated or simplified before automating them.
* Translate business problems into scalable technology solutions.
* Own technology economics including cloud, AI/token usage, software licences, development and outsourcing.
* Report technology performance to leadership in **business outcomes rather than project activity**.

**3. AI, Agents & Intelligent Automation**
==========================================

AI is not an innovation project at Ergode. It is becoming part of how the company operates.

You will:

* Identify high-volume and high-value manual work suitable for AI or automation.
* Build and deploy AI agents and GenAI workflows into **real production environments**.
* Develop reusable AI architecture rather than disconnected experiments.
* Integrate AI into areas including:
  + Catalogue and content
  + Marketplace listings
  + Pricing
  + Inventory
  + Customer support
  + Sales
  + Finance
  + HR
  + Reporting and decision support
* Build with LLM APIs, RAG, agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks and workflow automation.
* Establish before/after baselines for every major automation.
* Measure:
  + hours/FTE capacity saved
  + cycle-time reduction
  + cost reduction
  + quality improvement
  + revenue/margin impact
  + user adoption
* Kill pilots that do not produce value and scale the ones that do.
* Ensure business teams actually adopt what Technology builds.

### **We are not looking for:**

Someone who has attended AI courses or built demos.

### **We are looking for:**

Someone who has **put AI into production and can show what changed because of it.**

**4. E-commerce Platforms & Marketplace Technology**
====================================================

Our technology must support a complex global marketplace operation.

You will own and strengthen:

* Marketplace integrations including Amazon SP-API, Walmart, eBay and other channels.
* Catalogue and listing infrastructure.
* Pricing and quantity synchronization.
* Order processing.
* Inventory and warehouse integrations.
* Returns, refunds and reconciliation workflows.
* Marketplace reporting and operational intelligence.
* API reliability and monitoring.

You will build toward a connected architecture where catalogue, inventory, order and marketplace information flows reliably across systems.

The goal is not simply integration.

The goal is **reliable commerce at scale**.

**5. Product & Platform Ownership**
===================================

You will take ownership of Ergode’s core internal technology platforms and ensure they become dependable business systems.

This includes:

* evaluating existing architecture,
* identifying technical debt,
* establishing clear module ownership,
* improving reliability and usability,
* prioritising development based on business value,
* and driving adoption after launch.

Technology is not complete when code is deployed.

**A feature is complete when the business can reliably use it and the expected outcome is visible.**

**6. Data Foundation & Decision Intelligence**
==============================================

AI is only as strong as the underlying data.

You will:

* Build reliable data flows across business systems.
* Establish clear sources of truth for critical business information.
* Reduce duplicate datasets and manual reconciliation.
* Improve data quality and ownership.
* Enable dashboards and AI systems to consume trustworthy business data.
* Build APIs and integration layers that allow new agents and applications to be deployed quickly.

**7. Architecture, Cloud & Engineering Quality**
================================================

You should be technically strong enough to challenge architecture and engineering decisions yourself.

You will:

* Review architecture for scalability, reliability, maintainability, security and cost.
* Establish coding, testing, documentation and deployment standards.
* Strengthen CI/CD and monitoring.
* Review estimates rather than blindly accepting them.
* Prototype when speed requires it.
* Make pragmatic technology choices rather than over-engineering.

We expect a leader who can move comfortably between a **CEO conversation about ROI and an engineering conversation about architecture.**

**8. Security, Reliability & AI Governance**
============================================

You will own the reliability and security of Ergode’s technology environment.

Responsibilities include:

* Cloud and infrastructure reliability
* Monitoring and uptime
* Incident management
* Root-cause analysis
* Backups and disaster recovery
* Identity and access management
* SSO
* Endpoint/device security
* Data protection

You will also establish practical AI governance covering:

* which company information can be shared with which AI systems,
* permissions available to AI agents,
* human review requirements for critical decisions,
* auditability,
* and acceptable AI use.

Compliance should appropriately address DPDP and relevant international privacy/security requirements.

**9. Build vs Buy vs Outsource**
================================

We do not believe everything must be built internally.

We do believe **Ergode must own the outcome.**

You will decide when to:

**BUILD** — when capability creates strategic advantage.

**BUY** — when a reliable product already solves the problem economically.

**OUTSOURCE** — when an external specialist can deliver faster.

For outsourced work, you will own:

* requirements,
* architecture,
* vendor selection,
* commercial evaluation,
* milestones,
* SLAs,
* quality,
* security,
* source code,
* documentation,
* handover.

No critical Ergode technology should become permanently dependent on one vendor or individual.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first 6–12 months, we expect visible movement across these areas:

### **Execution**

* Major technology initiatives have clear owners, deadlines and outcomes.
* Delivery predictability improves materially.
* Chronic technology bottlenecks reduce.

### **AI & Automation**

* Multiple AI agents/workflows are operating in production.
* Automation impact is quantified monthly.
* Manual workload is measurably reduced in targeted processes.
* Business adoption is visible rather than assumed.

### **Core Platforms**

* Critical marketplace and internal systems become more reliable.
* Technical ownership and documentation improve.
* Important business workflows no longer depend on fragile manual processes.

### **Data**

* Critical catalogue, inventory, order and operational data become more connected and trustworthy.

### **Business Partnership**

* Business leaders increasingly bring problems to Technology because they expect **working solutions, not project discussions**.

**Who We Are Looking For**
==========================

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* 10+ years of meaningful technology experience.
* 5+ years leading engineering/technology teams.
* Evidence of personally owning major technology delivery.
* Strong understanding of software engineering, architecture, APIs and integrations.
* AI/automation systems deployed into production with measurable impact.
* Practical experience with:
  + LLM APIs
  + RAG
  + AI agents / agentic workflows
  + Python
  + workflow automation platforms such as n8n/Make or equivalent
* Cloud experience across AWS, Azure or GCP.
* API/integration architecture experience.
* DevOps, deployment and monitoring understanding.
* Ability to evaluate architecture, code/design decisions and engineering estimates.
* Experience managing external technology partners.
* Experience owning meaningful technology budgets.
* Strong business and commercial orientation.

**Strongly Preferred**
----------------------

Experience in one or more of:

* E-commerce
* Marketplaces
* Retail technology
* D2C
* SaaS/platform businesses
* ERP/OMS/WMS
* Amazon SP-API or other marketplace integrations
* High-volume order/catalogue/inventory systems
* AI-first enterprise transformation

**Who Will NOT Fit This Role**
==============================

This role is probably not for you if:

* Your experience is predominantly IT infrastructure/helpdesk.
* Your leadership style is primarily delegation without technical depth.
* Your AI experience consists mainly of courses, certifications or prototypes.
* You measure success by projects delivered rather than business outcomes achieved.
* You require large teams before you can execute.
* You prefer lengthy planning cycles over shipping, learning and improving.
* You cannot challenge engineers, vendors and business leaders when necessary.

**The Person Behind the Resume**
================================

We care about experience, but we care equally about how you operate.

We value people who demonstrate:

**Ownership. Bias for action. Curiosity. Commercial thinking. High standards. Candour. Learning velocity.**

We would rather hire a builder who has repeatedly solved difficult problems than someone with the perfect title.

:

title: Head of AI Solutions & Delivery
description:
**About TVARIT:**

TVARIT GmbH specializes in developing and delivering cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) solutions for the metal industry, including steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and more. Our software products empower customers to make intelligent, data-driven decisions, driving

advancements in Predictive Quality (PsQ), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), and Energy Consumption Reduction (PsE).

With a strong portfolio of renowned reference customers, state-of-the-art technology, a talented research team from prestigious universities, and recognition through esteemed awards such as the EU Horizon 2020 AI Prize, TVARIT is recognized as one of the most

innovative AI companies in Germany and Europe.

We are looking for a self-motivated person with a positive “can-do” attitude and excellent oral and written communication skills in English.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a senior leader to head TVARIT’s Metals Division, owning customer relationships, solution delivery, and the growth of our industrial AI business with steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and other metal producers and processors. The role calls for an engineer who combines first-hand manufacturing plant experience, ideally in metals, with strong data science and AI expertise and a proven record of leading software delivery with a team

The Head of AI Solutions & Delivery will be the senior face of TVARIT to metals customers, from the first discovery workshop through deployment and scaled adoption, and will be accountable for delivering projects on time, within scope, and with measurable impact on

quality, yield, uptime, and energy consumption. The role leads a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, software engineers, and domain experts, and turns successful deployments into reusable, scalable offerings for the metals sector.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Division Leadership & Growth:**

* Lead the Metals Division end to end, including strategy, customer portfolio, revenue and delivery targets, and division-level planning and reporting.
* Build, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, ML engineers, software engineers, and metallurgy/process domain experts; set clear goals, hiring plans, and standards of technical excellence.
* Define the division’s solution and product roadmap together with product and business teams, prioritizing use cases with recurring demand across steel, aluminum, and other metal processes.
* Grow existing accounts and win new business through solution design, technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, proof-of-concept planning, and commercial discussions.

**Customer Engagement:**

* Act as the senior technical and executive point of contact for metals customers, building trusted relationships with plant managers, process and quality engineers, IT/OT teams, and senior decision makers.
* Lead discovery discussions and requirements workshops, on the shop floor and in the boardroom, to understand manufacturing processes, operational challenges, existing systems, and business priorities.
* Translate customer needs into clearly defined use cases, solution concepts, highlevel architectures, implementation scope, and measurable success criteria.
* Present TVARIT’s capabilities through relevant project examples, demonstrations, and workshops, communicating methodology, technical differentiation, limitations, and expected business value credibly to technical and executive audiences

**Delivery Excellence:**

* Own delivery of all Metals Division projects, from scoping and data onboarding through model development, deployment, user adoption, and value realization, ensuring on-time, on-budget, high-quality outcomes.
* Establish delivery governance across projects: plans and milestones, risk and dependency management, customer status reporting, and escalation handling.
* Assess feasibility before commitment, considering data readiness, integration with PLC/SCADA, MES, and historians, deployment constraints, effort, and business impact; align customer commitments with team capacity and technical readiness.
* Track and demonstrate realized value (e.g., scrap reduction, yield, first-pass quality, energy per tonne, unplanned downtime) and use proven results to drive renewals and expansion.

**Technical, Data Science & AI Leadership:**

* Provide hands-on technical direction on data science and ML approaches for metal processes, including time-series modeling, predictive quality, predictive maintenance, process optimization, and hybrid physics-informed models.
* Review solution architectures and engineering practices for robustness, scalability, and maintainability; set standards for software delivery, MLOps, and model monitoring.
* Identify reusable intellectual property across projects, including models, algorithms, software components, and process expertise, and guide its development into configurable, scalable products for the metals sector with minimal incremental development where feasible.
* Stay current on industrial AI, including generative AI and industrial copilots, and evaluate where they add real value for metals customers.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering (Metallurgical, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Computer Science, or a related discipline); a postgraduate qualification in Data Science, AI, or Computer Science is an advantage.
* **10+ years of professional experience,** including substantial experience leading teams and customer engagements in industrial AI, manufacturing technology, industrial software, or technology-led solution delivery.
* **Mandatory manufacturing exposure:** direct experience working in or closely with manufacturing plants and their operations teams. Metals experience (e.g., steel, aluminum, copper, foundry/casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment) is strongly preferred; automotive, heavy engineering, or process manufacturing is also considered
* **Software delivery leadership:** must have led the delivery of software products or solutions with a team, with a solid working understanding of the software development lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance) and agile delivery practices. Hands-on coding exposure (e.g., Python) is mandatory; professional software development experience is an advantage.
* **Mandatory AI modeling experience:** strong understanding of AI/ML modeling (problem framing, feature engineering, model selection, validation, and deployment considerations) and hands-on involvement in AI/ML modeling projects, ideally on industrial, sensor, or time-series data.
* **Proven customer-facing leadership**, including requirements gathering, technical presentations, executive stakeholder management, and managing customer expectations through delivery
* **Proven delivery track record:** leading complex, multi-stakeholder technology projects to successful deployment, with accountability for timelines, scope, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience in solution architecture, presales, technical proposals, or productizing project work into reusable offerings.
* Strong people leadership, with experience building and mentoring high-performing technical teams; excellent written and verbal communication, structured problemsolving, and the ability to represent TVARIT confidently with senior stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel to customer plants as required.

**Technical Skills**

**Strong Haves**

* **Data science and AI:** Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, time-series analysis, anomaly detection, predictive and prescriptive analytics, optimization, and hybrid physics-informed modeling, with a clear view of their practical applications and limitations.
* **Metals process understanding:** Ability to relate process parameters in melting, casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment to quality, yield, scrap, energy consumption, equipment health, and operating cost.
* **Software development lifecycle:** Working understanding of how industrial software is planned, built, tested, released, and supported, including agile practices, CI/CD, code quality, and testing, sufficient to lead engineering teams and make sound delivery trade-offs. Hands-on coding exposure in Python is required, along with working familiarity with SQL.
* **Solution architecture and productization:** Translating business and operational requirements into functional specifications, reference architectures, and implementation roadmaps; reusable components, configurable solutions, model generalization, and validation across plants.

Familiarity Needed

* **Industrial data and integration:** Familiarity with PLC/SCADA systems, historians, MES, sensors, lab and quality data, and manufacturing data platforms, including data quality, contextualization, and OT/IT integration
* **Deployment and MLOps:** Cloud, edge, and on-premises deployment, MLOps, model monitoring and retraining, security, and reliability. Familiarity with Azure is preferred; AWS or GCP experience is also relevant.
* **Emerging AI:** Awareness of generative AI, LLMs, and industrial copilots, including their practical applications and limitations in manufacturing

title: AI Principle Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

AI Principle ArchitectMastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.  
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities  

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
* Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
* Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
* Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
* Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
* Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
* Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
* Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
* Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
* Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.

All About You  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
* Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
* A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
* The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
* Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
* Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Agentic AI Lead - VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Agentic AI Lead to drive the design, development and delivery of enterprise-scale agentic AI solutions across Vodafone’s Corporate AI Portfolio. This role will play a key part in shaping the future of AskHR, Vodafone’s AI-powered HR assistant, by defining agent architectures, advancing multi-agent orchestration across Google Cloud and Microsoft Copilot ecosystems, and creating reusable AI patterns for broader corporate functions. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with hands-on engineering leadership, enabling the delivery of secure, scalable and high-quality AI experiences that enhance employee productivity and experience globally.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

### **Agentic AI Engineering**

* Design, develop and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions, ranging from single-agent implementations to complex multi-agent systems.
* Implement advanced capabilities including tool and function calling, planning, memory management and agent orchestration.
* Apply emerging interoperability standards such as Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

### **Architecture & Knowledge Management**

* Evolve the AskHR AI architecture across Vertex AI Agent Builder, Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Engine and Gemini, integrating seamlessly with Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Drive improvements in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), grounding quality, chunking strategies, metadata filtering and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* Lead the transition from structured workflow-driven experiences to conversational, agent-led interactions.

### **Quality, Security & Operations**

* Establish robust evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge methodologies, regression testing and conversation analytics.
* Implement observability frameworks, performance monitoring and cost optimisation strategies.
* Embed responsible AI principles, privacy-by-design practices, GDPR compliance, prompt-injection protection and enterprise security controls.
* Define and implement LLMOps practices and CI/CD processes for prompts, agents and knowledge pipelines.

### **Technical Leadership**

* Mentor and support engineers across multiple squads through code reviews, technical guidance and engineering standards.
* Collaborate with architects, conversation designers, product owners and business stakeholders to align technical strategy with business objectives.
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and industry developments.

### **Initial Focus Areas**

* Define and secure adoption of a target agentic architecture across HR, Google Cloud, Copilot Studio and SAP platforms.
* Accelerate onboarding of HR journeys and knowledge sources through improved ingestion capabilities.
* Deliver scalable content ingestion pipelines that significantly reduce onboarding time for new data sources.
* Introduce evaluation-led release processes that improve answer quality and user containment rates.
* Prototype innovative employee experiences and contribute to the FY28 AI roadmap.

### **Broader Business Impact**

* Develop reusable agentic AI components, accelerators and reference architectures for HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Legal and other corporate domains.
* Provide technical leadership across expanding AI portfolios and support the scaling of successful AI solutions throughout the organisation.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Essential Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in senior software engineering, machine learning engineering or AI platform development, typically gained over 8+ years.
* Proven hands-on experience delivering production-scale generative AI, LLM and agentic AI solutions.
* Strong programming expertise in Python, with TypeScript experience considered advantageous.
* Deep expertise in either Google Cloud AI technologies (Vertex AI, Agent Builder, ADK, Gemini) or Microsoft AI technologies (Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework), alongside working knowledge of the alternative ecosystem.
* Strong understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, API design and enterprise integrations.
* Experience with cloud-native development, including containers, serverless platforms, infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices.
* Expertise in AI evaluation methodologies, observability platforms and production AI monitoring.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and supporting the growth of engineering talent.

### **Desirable Skills & Experience**

* Experience delivering AI solutions within HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement or other corporate functions.
* Knowledge of SAP integrations, including SAP SuccessFactors and SAP BTP.
* Experience with ServiceNow or comparable enterprise workflow platforms.
* Exposure to multilingual conversational AI solutions, regulated environments and global deployments.
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph or CrewAI.
* Relevant Google Cloud or Microsoft certifications.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

Opportunity to define and influence the future state of enterprise agentic AI architecture across a global organisation.Exposure to cutting-edge technologies spanning Google Cloud AI, Microsoft Copilot, Generative AI and multi-agent systems.Collaboration with global AI, architecture, HR and digital transformation teams.Opportunity to drive innovation through proof-of-concepts, experimentation and emerging technology adoption.Ability to create reusable solutions with impact across multiple business functions and global markets.Continuous learning within a rapidly evolving AI and cloud technology landscape.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

Advanced multi-agent architecture design and orchestration.Enterprise-scale implementation of Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).AI governance, responsible AI frameworks and secure enterprise AI deployment practices.End-to-end LLMOps, AI observability and automated evaluation methodologies.Integration of AI agents across SAP, Copilot Studio, Google Cloud and enterprise platforms.Scalable knowledge management, RAG optimisation and conversational AI design techniques.Strategic technology planning and AI portfolio leadership.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

description:

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. **OVERVIEW**

• **Support, maintain, and improve** third-party Enterprise Applications infrastructure through platform operations, administration, automation, monitoring, and cross-team delivery.

• **Own assigned operational activities with increasing independence** while following approved standards and partnering with senior engineers on complex issues, platform improvements, and project delivery.

• **Contribute to Infrastructure as Code and automation** using Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, and PowerShell to improve repeatability, reliability, and support efficiency.

• **Work closely with senior team members, infrastructure teams, application stakeholders, and vendors** to deliver stable services and build technical capability across E-Apps operations.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

• **Platform operations:** Support the health, availability, administration, monitoring, and continuous improvement of assigned E-Apps platforms.

• **Administration and maintenance:** Perform platform configuration, patching, upgrades, certificate updates, service management, access changes, backup checks, and routine maintenance across Windows and Linux environments.

• **Web and application platforms:** Administer and troubleshoot IIS, JBoss, and Apache, including application hosting, configuration, reverse proxy settings, ports, certificates, service restarts, and basic Java application troubleshooting.

• **Cloud and infrastructure:** Work with GCP resources and approved hybrid infrastructure patterns involving compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, SSL/TLS, storage, and connectivity.

• **Automation:** Create and maintain Terraform configurations, Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell or PowerShell scripts for repeatable operational tasks and standard process execution.

• **Observability and performance:** Use Datadog or equivalent tools to review metrics, logs, dashboards, alerts, health checks, and performance indicators; identify trends and escalate abnormal conditions.

• **Incident and ITSM support:** Resolve routine and moderately complex incidents, participate in incident and change processes, maintain knowledge articles and runbooks, and escalate issues with clear evidence and impact details.

• **Project delivery:** Support infrastructure and application activities for assigned projects, deployments, testing, environment readiness, and operational handover.

• **Continuous improvement:** Identify opportunities to improve reliability, patch compliance, monitoring, recovery readiness, documentation, and standard operating procedures.

• **Collaboration:** Work effectively with D&T, network, OS, security, application, and vendor teams while sharing operational knowledge and following platform standards.

• **Support Requirement:** Participate in extended off-hours shift coverage, including overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

• **Education:** Full-time graduation in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.

• **Experience:** Minimum 6 years of total IT experience, including at least 4 years supporting infrastructure or enterprise application platforms in production and business-critical environments.

• **GCP and infrastructure:** Hands-on experience with GCP services, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, load balancers, SSL/TLS certificates, DNS, networking, and access management.

• **Automation and scripting:** Practical experience with Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, or PowerShell for operational support, configuration, validation, and automation.

• **Middleware and platform administration:** Working experience with IIS, JBoss, and Apache across Windows and Linux platforms, including configuration, troubleshooting, patching, service management, and application integration.

• **Operating systems and databases:** Working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux administration, relational database concepts, and applications using Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.

• **Monitoring and operations:** Experience with Datadog or equivalent observability tools, incident handling, patching, operational documentation, and root-cause investigation.

• **ITSM and collaboration:** Working knowledge of incident, problem, change, service request, escalation, and knowledge-management practices, with strong stakeholder communication skills.

• **Core proficiency:** Ability to manage assigned tasks effectively, troubleshoot methodically, work across teams, and build new technical skills continuously.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

• **Cloud breadth:** Exposure to AWS or Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud platform.

• **Delivery practices:** Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, DevOps practices, and release or deployment automation.

• **Project methodology:** Understanding of project delivery methods, including the Advantage project management methodology.

• **Continuous improvement:** Applies analytical thinking and AI capabilities where they provide business value to improve support, operations, and productivity.

• **Professional behaviors:** Demonstrates accountability, initiative, reliability, integrity, teamwork, learning agility, and a positive service mindset.

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Senior SIEM Consultant
description:
At Securonix, we’re on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats, reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our Securonix Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with the first and only AI-Reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by Securonix EON’s AI capabilities, our innovative cloud-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep up with evolving threats.

Recognized as a five-time leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and highly rated on Gartner Peer Insights, our award-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of ‘hot’ data for rapid search and investigation, threat content-as-a-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR) experience—all within a single platform. Built on a cloud-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.

Securonix is proud to be a cybersecurity unicorn and featured in CRN's 2024 Security 100 list. Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the largest private equity firms with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than 1,000 customers  
worldwide, including 10% of the Fortune 100. Our network of 150+ partners and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.

At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do:

  

* Winning as One Team: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes
* Customer Driven Innovation: We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers
* Agility in Action: We embrace change and are unified in our purpose and objectives amidst change

  

Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team.

**Role Summary:**

The Senior SIEM Consultant position is an integral part of our Professional Services team. In this role, you will work with our customers , supporting our mission to help them quickly and completely adopt our Security Operating Platform, leaving them more secure. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that will focus on architecting, planning, implementing, and operationalizing the SIEM platform. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of information security and networking and extensive experience interacting with customers. Securonix Next-Gen SIEM and UEBA experience, although desired, is not required, but the candidate must have SIEM and SOAR software expertise and be willing to train on the Securonix platform and products.

**Primary Responsibility:**

  

* Lead end-to-end SIEM implementation or integrations in a customer environment.
* Understand customer business requirements and the threat landscape applicable to their industry’s vertical sector to develop tailored use cases for security and Incident monitoring.
* Coordinate with customers to deploy collectors and agents in the on-premises network for data collection and forwarding.
* Work with customers to design and implement secure data flow into the Securonix cloud, following industry-standard best practices.
* Coordinate with service delivery managers, management, engineering, maintenance, and operational support teams to ensure timely delivery.
* Develop content, use cases, data models, dashboards, and connectors to support custom user requirements.
* Troubleshooting end-to-end network and infrastructure issues during data onboarding.
* Deploy and integrate the Securonix SOAR solution with the customer infrastructure for response orchestration.
* Engage with customers and internal product development teams to gather user requirements, suggest new product features, and help improve existing ones.
* Training and enabling customers and partners for successful adoption.

  

**Minimum Requirements:**

  

* 8+ years of experience in information security and SIEM field.
* Strong understanding of SIEM solutions such as Splunk, Qradar, ArcSight, Logrhythm and Exabeam.
* Experience deploying SIEM acorss multiple customers.
* Good understanding of MITRE ATT&CK matrices, kill chains and other attack models.
* Strong communication skills and customer facing experience.
* Strong knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, Powershell.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM

  

**Preferred:**

  

* BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, CyberSecurity
* 3-4+ years of experience in UEBA deployment
* Working knowledge of Machine learning in cybersecurity
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies such as Amazon, Azure and Google
* Good understanding of log collection methodologies and aggregation techniques such as Syslog-NG, syslog, Nxlog, Windows Event Forwarding
* Good understanding of Hadoop ecosystem and Apache technologies.
* Experience integrating endpoint security and host-based intrusion detection solutions
* Experience with network forensics and toolsets such as Wireshark, PCAP, tcpdump

  

**Benefits:**

As a full-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits:

  

* Health Insurance with a total sum insured is INR 7,50,000
* Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents-in-law

title: Senior Associate - Quant Modeling
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Our Firmwide Risk Function is focused on cultivating a stronger, unified culture that embraces a sense of personal accountability for developing the highest corporate standards in governance and controls across the firm. Business priorities are built around the need to strengthen and guard the firm from the many risks we face, financial rigor, risk discipline, fostering a transparent culture and doing the right thing in every situation. We are equally focused on nurturing talent, respecting the diverse experiences that our team of Risk professionals bring and embracing an inclusive environment.

**Job summary**

As a Portfolio Risk Modeling Senior Associate within Consumer & Community Banking Risk Management, you will support critical statistical development projects and related analysis. You will design, develop, test, and validate statistical models for risk weight calculation, risk forecasting, and model performance monitoring. You will apply graduate-level research and analytical skills to perform data extraction, sampling, and statistical analyses using methods such as logistic regression, multinomial regression, multivariate analysis, discriminant analysis, time series analysis, and panel data analysis. You will design and produce programs to streamline and create repeatable procedures for model development, validation, and reporting. You will communicate and collaborate with business partners and model end-users to analyze and meet analysis and reporting needs.

**Job responsibilities**

* Design statistical models for risk weight calculation, risk forecasting, and model performance monitoring.
* Develop statistical models and related analytics to support critical development projects.
* Test models and supporting code to ensure accuracy and stability.
* Validate models and monitoring approaches, including documenting model performance.
* Perform data extraction, sampling, and statistical analyses using techniques such as logistic regression, multinomial regression, multivariate analysis, discriminant analysis, time series analysis, and panel data analysis.
* Build efficient programs to streamline and create repeatable procedures for model development, validation, and reporting.
* Communicate proactively with business partners and model end-users on analysis objectives, progress, and results.
* Collaborate with partners and end-users to define and meet analysis and reporting needs.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Qualified graduate with minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in statistical modeling within financial services industry
* Proficiency in advanced analytical languages such as R, Python, PySpark, and AWS
* Master's or Ph.D. degree in a technical or quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Technology
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong organization and time management skills, with the ability to deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines
* Strong multi-tasking skills, with demonstrated ability to manage expectations and deliver results
* Strong communication skills

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Knowledge of regulatory modeling (IFRS 9 / CECL / CCAR / Basel)

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

The CCB Data & Analytics team responsibly leverages data across Chase to build competitive advantages for the businesses while providing value and protection for customers. The team encompasses a variety of disciplines from data governance and strategy to reporting, data science and machine learning. We have a strong partnership with Technology, which provides cutting edge data and analytics infrastructure. The team powers Chase with insights to create the best customer and business outcomes.

title: Chief AI Architect
description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Chief AI Architect (CAIA) serves as the enterprise design authority for artificial intelligence at STERIS and leads the AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE) delivery organization, owning AI and agentic-AI architecture standards, solution reusability, technical-debt governance, and model/platform strategy end-to-end from proof-of-concept through production. Reporting to the Vice President & Chief Information Officer, the CAIA converts validated AI proof-of-concept value into governed, production-grade AI capability that supports the company growth strategy while managing regulatory and quality risk. As a peer to the Chief Enterprise Architect, the CAIA owns AI solution architecture, model strategy, and agentic-AI build decisions, while the Chief Enterprise Architect retains enterprise AI governance, policy, and audit-readiness oversight through the Architecture Review Board. The CAIA leads the AI CoE’s delivery pods (Product Management, POC, Development, and Operations) and drives a prioritized, value-scored AI project pipeline.

**Duties**
----------

* **AI CoE delivery leadership (20%).** Lead the AI Center of Excellence delivery organization (Delivery Lead, AI Product Management, POC “Factory,” Development, and AI Command Center/Operations pods); sustain a governed, prioritized pipeline of active AI projects from proof-of-concept through production.
* **AI production operations (10%).** Own monitoring, drift detection, and incident response for live AI workloads (est. 8–12 today); ensure production AI meets enterprise reliability, security, and quality standards.
* **Responsible-AI execution & governance partnership (10%).** Partner with the Chief Enterprise Architect and AI Governance Steering Committee/Review Board to execute human-in-the-loop, fail-closed controls at the solution level; build to EU AI Act, FDA CSV/CSA (GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11) requirements as directed by governance.
* **Demand pipeline & business translation (10%).** Direct AI Product Managers in translating business challenges into a prioritized, value-scored backlog; serve as the technical counterpart to business stakeholders on use-case feasibility and value.
* **Data & AI platform partnership (8%).** Partner with the Director, Data Engineering & Platform and Director, Data Governance & Management to ensure AI solutions run on trusted, governed data foundations.
* **Talent, training & AI adoption (7%).** Support the AI Enablement & Adoption Lead and AI Academy/Community programs; mentor AI Development and POC talent; build the CoE succession plan.
* **Consultant-to-FTE transition & vendor management (10%).** Own the transition of AI delivery from SOW-based consulting to a permanent, budgeted FTE organization; partner with Procurement and HR on hiring, onboarding, and AI tooling vendor consolidation.
* **Leadership:** Provides strategic leadership and direction for the function, leading and developing high-performing teams, driving organizational priorities, fostering a culture of accountability and collaboration, and ensuring the successful execution of business objectives aligned with the company's long-term goals.

**Duties - cont'd**
-------------------

**Education Degree**
--------------------

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Engineering General

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* 15 overall years of experience including: 8+ years in technology, 4+ years in AI/ML, data science, or enterprise architecture roles, and 2+ years leading an AI delivery function or team.
* Demonstrated production delivery of AI/GenAI solutions at enterprise scale; proven ability to convert proof-of-concept work into governed, production-grade capability.
* Experience standing up or scaling an AI Center of Excellence or comparable delivery organization.
* Regulated-industry experience (medical device, life sciences, healthcare, or similar) preferred; familiarity with FDA CSV/CSA (GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11), EU AI Act, and data-privacy (GDPR) obligations a plus.
* Progressive technology leadership experience
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams of AI professionals preferably for roles that support development and an AI Command Center/Operations.
* AI/GenAI and agentic-AI architecture, model strategy, and platform evaluation (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, Claude, Copilot).
* MLOps, production AI monitoring, drift detection, and incident response.
* Delivery organization leadership: pipeline management, resourcing, and pod-based delivery models (POC, development, operations).
* Executive stakeholder management and business translation (value-scoring, backlog prioritization).
* Team building, mentoring, and succession planning for a technical delivery organization
* Demonstrated success defining and executing enterprise-wide AI strategies aligned with business objectives and digital transformation goals.
* Experience influencing C-suite executives and senior business leaders on AI investments, innovation roadmaps, and technology strategy.
* Strong track record of building high-performing teams through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and talent development.
* Proven leadership in driving organizational change and fostering AI adoption across business functions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage large-scale AI programs, budgets, vendor relationships, and strategic technology partnerships.
* Experience leading enterprise architecture decisions and integrating AI solutions into complex technology ecosystems.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to align business, technology, legal, security, and compliance teams around strategic AI initiatives.
