title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

**Position Summary**

We are looking for a experienced AI/ML Engineer to design, build, and deploy machine learning models and intelligent systems that solve real business problems at scale. This role has a strong focus on modern generative AI — building LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI systems — alongside classical ML. You will work across the full ML/AI lifecycle, from data exploration and model development to production deployment and monitoring, partnering closely with Data Science, Product, and Platform Engineering teams. This role suits someone who enjoys turning research and prototypes into reliable, production-grade systems.

You will be reporting to Team Lead-IT

**Your Responsibilities**

* Design and build LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI workflows to automate and augment business processes.
* Stay current with the latest ML/AI research (including LLMs, RAG, and agentic systems) and evaluate applicability to company use cases.
* Document architectures, experiments, and decisions; contribute to internal ML standards, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Ensure responsible AI practices — fairness, explainability, privacy, and security — are embedded throughout model development
* Build and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines for feature engineering, model training, and inference (batch and real-time).
* Deploy models into production using MLOps best practices — CI/CD for ML, containerization, model versioning, and automated retraining pipelines.
* Monitor deployed models for drift, performance degradation, bias, and data quality issues; implement retraining and alerting strategies.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure clean, reliable, and well-governed data is available for model development.
* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into ML solutions and model capabilities, limitations, and trade-offs.
* Conduct experiments (A/B tests, offline evaluation) to validate model performance and business impact.
* Optimize models for latency, throughput, and cost (quantization, distillation, pruning, efficient inference serving).
  

  

**The Essentials – You Will Have**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Machine Learning, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 2–5+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in production (adjust based on seniority: 5–8+ years for Senior/Staff level).

**Technical Skills**

* Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with SQL
* Proficiency with ML/DL frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM.
* 5+ years of experience with the ML lifecycle: data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, hyperparameter tuning, evaluation, and deployment.
* Hands-on experience with MLOps tooling: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, Airflow, or similar for experiment tracking, orchestration, and deployment.
* Solid understanding of statistics, probability, linear algebra, and core ML/DL algorithms.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure) and containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with distributed data processing (Spark, Ray, Dask) and data pipeline/orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster).
* 5+ years of experience with model serving and APIs (FastAPI/Flask, TorchServe, Triton Inference Server, or similar).
* Version control (Git) and CI/CD practices for ML systems.

Generative AI, LLMs & Agentic Applications (Essential)

* Hands-on experience building applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) — e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Llama, Mistral, or Gemini APIs.
* Practical experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including chunking strategies, embeddings, and retrieval evaluation.
* Experience building agentic AI systems / multi-step autonomous workflows (tool use, function calling, planning, orchestration) using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar.
* Working knowledge of vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Milvus, Chroma) for semantic search and retrieval at scale.
* Experience with prompt engineering, evaluation, and fine-tuning/adapting LLMs (LoRA, PEFT) for domain-specific use cases.
* Understanding of the trade-offs, latency, cost, and safety considerations of deploying LLM- and agent-based applications in production.
  

  

**The Preferred – You Might Also Have**

* Experience deploying and scaling multi-agent systems in production (orchestration, memory, guardrails, observability for agentic workflows).
* Contributions to open-source LLM/RAG tooling, or published work on GenAI applications.
* Publications, open-source contributions, or Kaggle competition experience.
* Experience with real-time/streaming ML systems (Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming).
* Domain experience relevant to the business (e.g., fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, cybersecurity).
* Understanding of responsible AI, model interpretability (SHAP, LIME), and privacy-preserving ML techniques.

Tools & Technology (Representative)

* Languages: Python, SQL
* ML/DL: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers
* GenAI / LLM: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LlamaIndex, RAG pipelines, vector DBs (Pinecone/Weaviate/FAISS)
* MLOps: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker/Vertex AI/Azure ML, Airflow
* Data: Spark, Pandas, Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift
* Infra: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/Azure, Terraform
* Monitoring: Prometheus/Grafana, Evidently AI, WhyLabs
  

  

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes:

* Comprehensive mindfulness programmed with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time Off available after 6 months of employment

* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalised wellbeing programmed through our OnTrack programmed

title: Sr. System Administrator
description:
**Senior Server Administrator – IT Infrastructure**
===================================================

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Senior Server Administrator is responsible for the design, administration, maintenance, security, and continuous improvement of the organisation’s server and IT infrastructure environment. The role will ensure that infrastructure services remain secure, resilient, highly available, and aligned with business requirements.

The successful candidate will provide senior-level technical expertise across physical and virtual server environments, operating systems, storage, backup, monitoring, patching, and infrastructure security. They will also play a key role in incident resolution, infrastructure projects, service improvements, and technical planning.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Server & Infrastructure Administration**

* Administer and maintain Windows and/or Linux server environments across physical and virtual platforms.
* Manage server hardware, operating systems, virtualisation platforms, storage, and associated infrastructure services.
* Monitor system performance, capacity, availability, and health, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
* Perform server builds, configuration, upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning in accordance with established standards.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, configuration records, and technical procedures.
* Ensure infrastructure platforms are appropriately configured for availability, performance, and resilience.

### **Infrastructure Operations & Support**

* Provide senior-level technical support for infrastructure incidents, service requests, and problems.
* Troubleshoot complex server, operating system, networking, storage, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Participate in an on-call or out-of-hours support rota where required.
* Lead or support the resolution of major incidents and provide root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Work closely with service desk, network, security, application, and other IT teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

### **Security & Compliance**

* Maintain server security in line with organisational policies and industry best practices.
* Manage operating system patching, vulnerability remediation, antivirus/endpoint protection, and security configuration.
* Support security audits, compliance requirements, and infrastructure risk assessments.
* Implement and maintain appropriate access controls, privileged access, and server hardening standards.
* Work with cybersecurity teams to investigate and remediate infrastructure security incidents.

### **Backup, Recovery & Business Continuity**

* Manage and monitor server backup and recovery solutions.
* Regularly test backup restoration and disaster recovery procedures.
* Support the development and maintenance of infrastructure disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Ensure critical infrastructure services meet agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives.

### **Projects & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead or contribute to infrastructure projects, including server upgrades, migrations, cloud adoption, virtualisation, and technology refresh programmes.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure services.
* Identify opportunities to automate routine administration and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain technical standards, processes, and best-practice procedures.
* Support capacity planning and future infrastructure strategy.

### **Stakeholder & Supplier Management**

* Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, and third-party suppliers.
* Provide technical guidance and communicate complex infrastructure issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support supplier management, technical reviews, and service improvement activities where required.
* Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior infrastructure team members.

**Essential Skills & Experience**
---------------------------------

* Significant experience in a senior server/infrastructure administration role.
* Strong experience administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments.
* Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and core infrastructure services.
* Experience with virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Strong understanding of server hardware, storage, networking, and infrastructure architecture.
* Experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Strong knowledge of server security, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and hardening.
* Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure incidents and performing root-cause analysis.
* Good understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management processes.
* Experience working with monitoring and infrastructure management tools.
* Strong documentation and technical communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical issues.

**Desirable Skills**
--------------------

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure platforms.
* Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting/automation technologies.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience with enterprise storage technologies.
* Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery architectures.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Linux, ITIL, or cloud certifications.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* **Technical expertise:** Demonstrates strong knowledge of server and infrastructure technologies.
* **Problem solving:** Able to diagnose complex technical problems and develop effective solutions.
* **Ownership:** Takes responsibility for infrastructure services and follows issues through to resolution.
* **Communication:** Communicates clearly with technical teams, management, suppliers, and business stakeholders.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identifies opportunities to improve reliability, security, performance, and efficiency.
* **Teamwork:** Works effectively across IT teams and supports knowledge sharing.
* **Resilience:** Able to manage priorities and remain effective during incidents and high-pressure situations.

**Key Performance Indicators**
------------------------------

* Infrastructure availability and reliability.
* Timely resolution of infrastructure incidents and problems.
* Successful completion of infrastructure projects and upgrades.
* Server patching and vulnerability remediation compliance.
* Backup success rates and successful recovery testing.
* Infrastructure security and compliance performance.
* Reduction in recurring incidents and infrastructure-related risks.
* Quality and accuracy of infrastructure documentation.
* Delivery of automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Senior Server Administrator will be a key member of the IT Infrastructure team, responsible for ensuring the stability, security, resilience, and performance of critical server and infrastructure services. The role requires a proactive and technically capable individual who can manage day-to-day operations while also contributing to strategic infrastructure improvements and business continuity.

title: Lead Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Lead Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Oracle RAC**

**Self-Managed Oracle RAC | HA/DR | Performance | Automation | Engineering Influence**

**Level**

Lead DBRE

**Domain**

Oracle RAC and Mission-Critical Relational Infrastructure

**Primary Focus**

Hands-on Oracle RAC reliability, lifecycle ownership, technical escalation, automation, application partnership, and cross-functional execution

**Work Expectations**

U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

**1. Role Summary**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Lead DBRE with deep hands-on expertise in Oracle Database and self-managed Oracle RAC environments. The role owns technical execution for a major Oracle domain and improves reliability, performance, scalability, lifecycle management, automation, and operational discipline.

Beyond traditional DBA operations, the Lead DBRE partners with application and infrastructure teams to influence schema, SQL, connection management, resiliency, observability, and safe deployment practices. The role remains hands-on while providing technical leadership, mentoring, and incident escalation.

**2. Level Scope and Leadership Expectations**
==============================================

Lead DBRE is a senior technical leadership role focused on owning execution for a major database domain. The expectation is to solve difficult production problems, lead initiatives end to end, guide engineers, create durable operating standards, and drive cross-functional closure without default people-management responsibility.

**Dimension**

**Expectation at This Level**

**Scope of Ownership**

Owns reliability and execution for a significant Oracle platform domain, including incidents, lifecycle activities, routine maintenance, capacity risks, HA/DR readiness, and service-impacting improvements.

**Technical Depth**

Diagnoses complex RAC, Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, SQL performance, storage, interconnect, OS, backup, and recovery problems.

**Technical Leadership**

Acts as a primary escalation point, mentors engineers, reviews designs, raises standards, and influences application and infrastructure decisions.

**Execution**

Leads complex initiatives end to end, aligns stakeholders, manages dependencies, and drives permanent corrective actions to closure.

**Communication**

Explains technical tradeoffs, communicates clearly during incidents, and keeps risks, ownership, dependencies, and timelines visible.

**Automation and Standards**

Builds repeatable automation, CI/CD practices, runbooks, monitoring, and golden paths that reduce toil and failure risk.

**3. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

**A. Oracle RAC Platform Ownership**
------------------------------------

* Administer and improve Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, Clusterware, ASM, services, SCAN/listeners, and interconnect configurations.
* Plan and execute patching, upgrades, migrations, capacity changes, and lifecycle activities with controlled change and rollback practices.
* Design, operate, and validate Data Guard, RMAN, backup/recovery, failover, switchover, and disaster-recovery procedures.

**B. Performance and Incident Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Lead performance analysis using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans, SQL Trace, TKPROF, and OS/storage diagnostics.
* Diagnose Cache Fusion, GC waits, workload placement, connection storms, cluster instability, storage latency, and interconnect issues.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for critical incidents, lead stabilization and RCA, and drive permanent corrective actions.

**C. Engineering Influence and Shift-Left Reliability**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Partner with application teams on SQL, indexing, partitioning, schema design, bind usage, connection pooling, transaction boundaries, and resilient failover behavior.
* Establish database design reviews, deployment guardrails, developer guidance, and production-readiness standards.

**D. Automation and Observability**
-----------------------------------

* Automate provisioning, validation, patching, maintenance, backup checks, DR exercises, health checks, and recurring remediation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
* Improve Oracle observability using OEM, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable tools; define actionable service indicators and objectives.

**4. Required Qualifications and Experience**
=============================================

* 8+ years of database or reliability engineering experience, including significant Lead or Senior responsibility for self-managed production Oracle RAC.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure/Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, RAC Services, SCAN/listeners, Cache Fusion, and interconnect behavior.
* Strong Oracle performance tuning and diagnostics experience using AWR, ASH, execution plans, SQL Trace, and Linux diagnostics.
* Experience with patching, upgrades, migrations, backup/recovery, DR exercises, and controlled production change.
* Strong Linux/Unix systems troubleshooting skills.
* Hands-on automation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or comparable tooling.
* Strong technical leadership, mentoring, incident communication, and cross-functional execution skills.

**5. Preferred Qualifications**
===============================

* Oracle Exadata, OCI, Cloud@Customer, AWS, or hybrid Oracle deployment experience.
* Application Continuity, FAN, TAF, FSFO, Far Sync, GoldenGate, GDS, TDE, ZDLRA, or advanced Oracle HA capabilities.
* Database schema CI/CD using Liquibase, Flyway, Bytebase, or comparable tooling.
* Oracle certifications or relevant SRE/cloud architecture credentials.

**6. Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months**
=================================================

* Establish measurable reliability, MTTR, patching, backup/recovery, and DR-readiness baselines and deliver material improvement.
* Automate high-frequency and high-risk operational workflows, prioritizing safety, maintainability, and auditability.
* Establish a practical database architecture and production-readiness review process with measurable adoption by application teams.
* Deliver documented capacity, lifecycle, resiliency, and corrective-action plans for critical RAC environments.

**7. What This Role Does Not Include**
======================================

* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is expected through technical direction, mentoring, and execution ownership.
* This is not a project-management-only role; the Lead DBRE must remain deeply hands-on.
* This is not a traditional DBA ticket queue; durable fixes, automation, standards, capacity planning, and reliability improvements are expected.
* This role does not own application code or business logic, although it influences database-impacting application design.
* The role does not assume unlimited or last-minute DBRE capacity; work must be planned, prioritized, communicated, and committed through the appropriate process.

**8. Work Expectations and Location**
=====================================

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
AppZen is the leader in autonomous spend-to-pay software. Its patented artificial intelligence accurately and efficiently processes information from thousands of data sources so that organizations can better understand enterprise spend at scale to make smarter business decisions. It seamlessly integrates with existing accounts payable, expense, and card workflows to read, understand, and make real-time decisions based on your unique spend profile, leading to faster processing times and fewer instances of fraud or wasteful spend. Global enterprises, including one-third of the Fortune 500, use AppZen’s invoice, expense, and card transaction solutions to replace manual finance processes and accelerate the speed and agility of their businesses. To learn more, visit us at www.appzen.com.

### **About the role :**

We are looking for an **AI/ML Engineer** with 1–3 years of experience to join our growing AI team. In this role, you will build and ship the **LLM-powered and agentic features** that read, understand and make decisions on invoices, expense reports and card transactions for some of the world’s largest finance teams. You will work alongside senior AI/ML engineers, data scientists and product managers to take features from prototype to production, and own them once they are live. If you enjoy turning the latest advances in LLMs and agents into reliable and measurable products, AppZen is the place for you.

### **Key Responsibilities :**

* **LLM & Agent Development:** Build and improve LLM-powered features and multi-step agentic workflows (e.g., using LangGraph) that extract, validate and reason over invoices, receipts, expense reports and card transactions.
* **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):** Build retrieval pipelines (chunking, embeddings, vector search and re-ranking) that give models the right policy, vendor and transaction context to make accurate financial decisions.
* **Tool Use & Structured Outputs:** Implement function calling and API integrations so that models can reliably query internal services and ERP/AP systems, and return validated, structured (JSON) outputs.
* **Evaluation & Quality:** Build evaluation datasets, metrics and automated test suites to measure accuracy, hallucination rate, latency and cost, and use the results to improve prompts, retrieval and models.
* **Production Engineering:** Package and deploy models and services using Docker and CI/CD pipelines, add monitoring and logging, and keep them reliable, scalable and cost-efficient in production.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Work closely with senior engineers, data scientists and product managers to turn customer and business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions, and contribute to code reviews and design discussions.

### **Required Skills :**

* **Professional Experience:** 1–3 years of experience building and deploying ML/AI solutions in production, including at least 1 year of hands-on work on LLM-based applications.
* **Programming:** Strong **Python** skills, with experience writing clean, tested, production-grade code and building REST APIs (e.g., FastAPI or Flask).
* **LLM & Agent Frameworks:** Hands-on experience with **LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex** or similar frameworks, and with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) or open-source models.
* **RAG & Vector Databases:** Practical experience building RAG pipelines using vector databases such as **Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector or FAISS**.
* **Prompting & Structured Outputs:** Good understanding of prompting techniques (few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, ReAct) and of getting reliable structured outputs and function calls from LLMs.
* **ML Fundamentals:** Solid grounding in ML and NLP fundamentals, with working experience in **PyTorch** or a similar framework. Exposure to fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA) is a plus.
* **MLOps & Cloud:** Working knowledge of Docker, Git and CI/CD, and experience deploying on a cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure). Familiarity with LLM observability tools (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Weights & Biases) is a plus.
* **Good to Have:** Experience with document AI (OCR, invoice or receipt data extraction) or with finance, accounts payable or expense data.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

We may use artificial intelligence tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.

title: Splunk Platform Architect
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Our team acts as a trusted technical partner for our customers, helping them navigate the complexities of hybrid and multi-cloud environments. We are a collaborative group of high performing data platform solution architects, positioned right at the intersection of our customers, field technical sellers, sellers and product teams. We value innovation, curiosity, and the open exchange of ideas with hunger to learn and make a difference. We believe the best solutions come from working together, and we pride ourselves on fostering a supportive environment where you can grow your expertise in AI and Splunk data architecture. If you’re a problem-solver who loves to share ideas, brings practical service provider (telecom) industry knowledge and delivers impactful results in the shape of technical business outcomes, we’d love to have you on the team.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As Splunk Platform Architect, you will serve as a trusted technical and strategic advisor to service provider leaders across the region. You will bridge complex telecommunications and network challenges with modern data platforms, observability, and AI to transform operations and monetize digital capabilities.
  
  

* Engage service provider executives and senior technical stakeholders to understand strategic priorities, operational challenges, and transformation goals. Explore areas of focus and uncover customer pain points. Once discovered, shape data and AI strategies for network operations, service assurance, customer experience, automation, security, and business operations.
* Design and communicate solution architectures spanning telemetry, observability, security data, network data, enterprise data platforms, analytics, and AI.
* Translate complex service provider challenges into practical platform strategies, solution architecture and working prototypes.
* Demonstrate how data platforms such as Splunk can help organisations improve visibility, reduce operational complexity, accelerate incident response, and enable data-driven decisions.
* Work closely with account teams, sales specialists, solution engineers, customer success, professional services, partners, and product teams.
* Enable field teams and customers through workshops, executive briefings, architecture sessions, demonstrations, and industry engagements.
* Identify repeatable patterns and differentiated use cases across various domains including 5G, cloud, OSS/BSS, network automation, observability, cybersecurity, and customer experience.
* Work with service providers to identify, shape, and solution API monetisation services. Connect business opportunities to architectures that expose network and digital capabilities through APIs, and consider the supporting data, analytics, security, integration, and operational requirements needed to deliver customer and partner value.
* Contribute to thought leadership through customer presentations, white papers, industry forums, and events such as TM Forum and Mobile World Congress.
* Bring external market, technology, and customer insights back into business strategy, solution development, and field enablement.

**Success Measures:**  

* Establishing trusted relationships with senior service provider stakeholders.
* Creating differentiated data and AI architecture strategies, designs, use cases and prototypes that address real operational and business challenges.
* Influencing customer adoption of modern data platform capabilities.
* Enabling account teams and partners to have stronger, more strategic customer conversations.
* Building repeatable service provider use cases and architecture patterns that can be rolled out to others.
* Strengthening the organisation’s position as a thought leader in service provider data-driven transformation.

The ideal candidate can move comfortably from a product discussion to an industry conversation to an enterprise data and transformation strategy-design and should be able to build prototypes when needed.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 12+ years experience in the telecommunications or service provider industry, with credibility across network, cloud, operations, assurance, automation, security, or customer experience domains.
* Deep experience in one or two service provider domains, combined with a sound working understanding of the others. Relevant domains include fixed wireline, wireless, mobile core, RAN, packet core, optical, transport/IP, 5G, network functions virtualization, cloud-native networking, OSS/BSS, network automation, and service assurance.
* The ability to communicate effectively with service provider executives, enterprise architects, network architects, NOC/SOC leaders, operations teams, and engineering organizations.
* Experience developing or influencing complex solution architectures in large-scale, multi-domain environments, and the ability to connect business outcomes and operational challenges to platform capabilities and architecture decisions.
* A strong understanding of data platforms, data architecture, telemetry, observability, analytics, AI, or security data solutions. Experience with Splunk or other enterprise data, observability, analytics, cloud, or security platforms is valuable.
* Knowledge of Cisco and other technologies and architectures relevant to service providers, as well as an understanding of autonomous and agentic architectures.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Strong executive handling, consulting skills, storytelling ability, and confidence leading strategic customer conversations. Experience working across sales, presales, product, engineering, delivery, and customer success teams is valuable.
* A curious, collaborative, and commercially minded approach, with the ability to operate across strategic and technical conversations.
* Experience advising customers on platform adoption, operating models, data governance, or transformation roadmaps. A background in enterprise architecture, consulting, technical sales, solution architecture, or senior customer advisory roles is valuable.
* Familiarity with TM Forum frameworks, Open APIs, industry standards, or service provider transformation programmes.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

description:

Deliver test-data provisioning by extracting, subsetting, refreshing, cloning, masking or generating data using approved TDM platforms and scripts while preserving referential integrity and usability.  
Develop automation and reusable capabilities, including repeatable workflows, utilities, templates and self-service solutions that reduce manual effort and improve turnaround times.  
Manage requests through agreed ticketing processes, maintaining appropriate evidence, status updates, blockers and closure information while meeting service levels.  
Write and optimise SQL for data analysis, extraction, transformation, validation and reconciliation.  
Coordinate with DBAs, environment teams, application owners, security teams and testers to resolve dependencies.  
Support incident analysis and root-cause investigation for data defects, failed jobs and environment issues.  
Contribute to Agile delivery through sprint execution, backlog refinement and collaboration within Scrum, Kanban or SAFe environments.  
Support API integration and partner onboarding and testing activities, including reusable integration documentation, data mappings and technical artefacts.

---------------

You have a degree or higher degree in software engineering or a related technical discipline.  
You have strong SQL and relational database knowledge, including joins, procedures, constraints, query tuning, data validation, relational models, keys and dependencies.  
You have experience with relational database technologies such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, DB2, MySQL or equivalent.  
You have practical TDM engineering knowledge covering data discovery, subsetting, masking, synthetic data generation, refresh, cloning and referential integrity.

You have scripting and workflow automation experience using technologies such as Python, Shell, PowerShell, REST APIs and CI/CD tooling.

* Take end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents and contribute directly to protecting customers, services, data and operations.

* Gain exposure to complex cybersecurity incidents across multiple intake channels and production environments.

Advanced cybersecurity incident triage, investigation and prioritisation.  
Alert, log and IoC correlation across security environments.  
Risk and business-impact assessment.  
Incident escalation and cross-functional response coordination.  
Audit-ready cybersecurity incident documentation.  
Stakeholder communication during complex and high-priority incidents.  
End-to-end incident lifecycle and SLA management.

* Must be a team player able to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing tasks and demands
* Strong communication skills; oral, written and presentation
* Strong organization, planning and time management skills to achieve results
* Strong personal and professional ethical values and integrity
* Takes ownership of meeting goals and standards
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel)

title: Process Manager - Monitoring & Event Management
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**

As the **Monitoring & Event Management Process Manager**, you will provide hands-on technical leadership and direction for enterprise monitoring, observability, and event-management practice. You will assess existing practices and operational maturity, identify gaps and risks, and define a practical improvement roadmap aligned with business-critical service requirements.

You will collaborate with IT service owners, architects, operations and engineering teams, Incident and Problem Management teams, Cybersecurity, and external service providers.

Your primary responsibility will be to define and document monitoring practices and guidelines, while introducing or supporting the enhancement of forward-looking monitoring solutions for IT services using modern technologies such as AI. These efforts should improve event quality, reduce alert noise, accelerate detection and recovery, enable predictive operations, and support safe automation.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Assess the maturity of current monitoring and event-management practices across processes, people, tools, data, governance, and operating models.
* Identify monitoring coverage gaps, architectural weaknesses, operational risks, recurring failure patterns, alert noise, manual toil, and barriers to effective service visibility.
* Define the target-state architecture, standards, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for monitoring, observability, event management, and AIOps.
* Lead the evaluation, selection, design, integration, and implementation of enterprise grade monitoring & observability solutions covering metrics, logs, traces, events, topology, and digital experience signals.
* Establish service-oriented monitoring by mapping applications, infrastructure, cloud services, dependencies, and configuration items to business services and service objectives.
* Improve event detection, severity models, thresholds, filtering, deduplication, enrichment, correlation, routing, escalation, and response workflows.
* Introduce AIOps use cases such as anomaly detection, event correlation, probable root-cause analysis, incident summarization, predictive insights, and assisted remediation.
* Integrate monitoring platforms with IT service-management, configuration-management, notification, collaboration, and automation solutions.
* Lead technical workshops, architecture reviews, proofs of concept, product evaluations, vendor engagements, and implementation projects from design through operational handover.
* Define governance, onboarding standards, operating procedures, support models, ownership, documentation, training, and compliance controls.
* Review monitoring outcomes and incident trends regularly, prioritize continual-improvement initiatives, and track benefits such as reduced alert volume, lower mean time to detect and recover, improved coverage, and increased automation.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in IT operations, DevOps, SRE, observability, monitoring, or platform engineering, including technical leadership or architecture responsibility.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of metrics, logs, traces, events, synthetic monitoring, real-user monitoring, application performance monitoring, infrastructure monitoring, network monitoring, and service dependency mapping.
* Experience with enterprise observability and monitoring technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, SolarWinds, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, or comparable platforms.
* Practical knowledge of SRE principles, including service-level indicators, service-level objectives, error budgets, the four golden signals, reliability reviews, toil reduction, capacity planning, and blameless learning.
* Experience designing or implementing AIOps use cases using machine learning, analytics, or generative AI for anomaly detection, event correlation, root-cause support, prediction, automation, and incident assistance.
* Strong knowledge of cloud and hybrid infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, microservices, APIs, networking, security, and resilient distributed-system architecture.
* Automation and scripting capability using Python, PowerShell, Bash, REST APIs, webhooks, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and CI/CD practices.
Working knowledge of ITIL practices, particularly Monitoring & Event Management, Incident Management, Availability Management, Capacity & Performance Management, and Continual Improvement.  

**Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications in SRE, DevOps, cloud architecture, Kubernetes, ITIL, observability, ServiceNow, or enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms for operational telemetry, including scalable storage, stream processing, and data-quality governance.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and managed-service providers in complex enterprise environments.

**Key Competencies**

* SRE and DevOps Technical Leadership
* Enterprise Monitoring and Observability Architecture
* Monitoring & Event Management Process Governance
* AIOps Strategy and Responsible Automation
* Operational Maturity Assessment and Road mapping
* Program Delivery, Vendor Management, and Stakeholder Influence
* Data-Driven Continual Improvement and Benefits Realization

title: Lead AI Engagement Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions.

The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It combines architecture and engineering with a set of functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the demand side: what gets built, why it is worth building, whether anyone uses it, and whether it actually works once live.

 **Job Description**

The **Lead AI Engagement Specialist** owns a portfolio of AI workflows within one or more business functions, end to end. You will identify where AI genuinely changes how the work is done, redesign that work, write the PRD, drive the build with the architect and engineers, land the adoption, and then manage the performance of the agents in production as a product you are accountable for.

This is a product and transformation role, not a business analysis role. The distinction matters and we mean it: you will own a roadmap, write specifications precise enough to build from, make scope calls, and be measured on realised value rather than on delivered documentation. If a workflow does not clear its quality bar or nobody uses it, that is your problem to solve, not to report.

**Where this role sits**

**Reports to:** Head of the AI Centre of Excellence

**Alignment:** Dotted line to the leadership of the business function you cover

**Works with:** AI Engagement specialists, Lead AI Architect and Senior AI Engineer daily; external implementation partners; Security, GRC, Legal and Data teams as required

**Owns:** The prioritised workflow pipeline, PRDs, roadmap, adoption and live agent performance for one function. Lead & manage other AI Engagement specialists.

**Accountable for:** Realised, measured business value — not deployment count

**What you will own**

**Opportunity identification and prioritisation**

* Own the AI workflow pipeline for your function — a ranked, evidence-based view of where AI creates value, refreshed as the business and the technology move.
* Distinguish rigorously between work that AI genuinely changes and work that merely looks automatable in a demo — and be willing to argue that a well-sponsored idea is not worth building.
* Prioritise on value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and time to impact, in partnership with the architect.

**Process discovery and workflow redesign**

* Map the current state properly: volumes, cycle times, cost to serve, exception paths, decision points, systems and data touched, and where the work actually breaks — grounded in observation and data, not in what the process document claims.
* Redesign the work, not just the tool. Decide what the agent does, what the human does, where the handoff sits, what the escalation path is, and what changes in roles, policies, SOPs and controls as a consequence.
* Design the human-in-the-loop model with the architect: where review is mandatory, where an agent may act autonomously, and how a wrong action is caught and reversed.

**Business case and value ownership**

* Build the business case: baseline metrics, benefit hypothesis, quantified target, build and run cost, payback and sensitivity — and the honest version of it, including the case against building.
* Establish the baseline before launch. A benefit that cannot be measured against a pre-existing baseline will not be believed, and should not be.
* Own benefits realisation after go-live — report the real number, including when it is below target, and recommend iterate, rebuild or retire accordingly.

**Product specification and roadmap**

* Write the PRD: problem, users, scope and non-scope, target workflow, acceptance criteria, quality bar, data and system dependencies, non-functional expectations, risks, and success metrics — detailed enough that the architect and engineers can design and build from it without a translation layer.
* Own the roadmap for your function: sequencing, dependencies, release planning, and a defensible view of what comes next and why.
* Partner with delivery daily — make scope calls, resolve ambiguity, unblock, test, and accept. Be available to engineers at the pace they work.

**Agent performance management**

* Define the quality bar in measurable terms with engineering — what a correct output is, what an acceptable error rate is, and what failure mode is unacceptable at any rate.
* Build and curate the evaluation datasets for your workflows, drawing on real cases from your function.
* Review live agent output on an ongoing basis and run the feedback loop back into engineering.
* Monitor production performance — accuracy and quality, containment or deflection, escalation rate, latency, cost per transaction, and user satisfaction — and drive the iteration cycle.
* Treat a live agent as a product under active management, not a project that was completed.

**Adoption and change**

* Own adoption as an outcome you are measured on: enablement, training, communications, champions, policy and SOP updates, and management routines.
* Instrument usage and act on what it shows — including the uncomfortable finding that a well-built workflow is being avoided.
* Engage with resistance seriously. Where people are working around the agent, understand why before attempting to change the behaviour.
* Work with function leadership on role definition, capacity and performance expectations as work is redesigned.

**Governance and CoE contribution**

* Ensure workflows meet responsible AI, data handling, privacy and approval requirements, working with Security, GRC and Legal.
* Feed reusable patterns back into the CoE so that a solved problem in one function does not get re-solved from scratch in another.

 **Qualifications**

* 7+ years in product management, business or digital transformation, operations strategy, or top-tier consulting — with a track record of change that shipped and stuck, not recommendations that were accepted.
* Demonstrable ownership of product specifications or PRDs that engineering teams built from. We will ask to discuss one in detail.
* Strong process redesign capability. Lean, Six Sigma, service design or similar training is welcome; evidence of redesigned work in production matters more than certification.
* Business case and value modelling — comfort with baselines, unit economics, cost to serve and payback, and the intellectual honesty to model the downside.
* Data literacy: able to interrogate data, work with BI tooling, and define and track metrics that hold up to scrutiny.
* Working fluency in what current AI systems can and cannot do — retrieval, agents, hallucination and grounding, evaluation, human-in-the-loop, and cost. Enough to scope realistically with engineers and to push back on hype and on pessimism with equal confidence. Coding is not required.
* Change management and adoption experience with real end users, including users who did not ask for the change.
* Strong influence at senior levels without formal authority, and the standing to tell a function leader that their favourite idea is not the right first build.
* Excellent written communication — clear specifications, clear reasoning, clear status.
* Deep functional expertise in the business function this opening covers — the specific requirements are set out under “Functional depth” below.

**Functional depth**

This role requires credibility with practitioners and leaders inside the function from the first week. We are looking for someone who understands how the work is genuinely done — its operating rhythm, its systems, its economics and its performance measures — well enough to challenge how it is done today rather than to describe it.

**Strongly preferred**

* Enterprise B2B SaaS experience.
* Manufacturing, supply chain or ERP domain knowledge.
* Having deployed AI or automation into production and lived with the results — including a deployment that underperformed and what you did about it.
* Experience operating across multiple regions and time zones.
* Experience working alongside system integrators or external delivery partners.

**What this role is not**

* Not a process documentation role. Mapping is an input; redesigned, adopted, measured work is the output.
* Not a change communications role. You own the product, not the announcement.
* Not a requirements-gathering role. You will not hand a wish list to engineering and wait; you will specify, decide and stay accountable through production.
* Not a role that ends at go-live. Managing agent performance afterwards is a permanent part of the job.

**What success looks like**

**First 3 months**

* A credible, ranked workflow pipeline for your functions, grounded in real process data and endorsed by function leadership.
* The first one or two PRDs written and accepted into build by the architect and engineering without a translation gap.
* Baselines established for the metrics your first workflows will move.

**First 6 months**

* First workflows live in production, with adoption instrumented and quality actively monitored.
* A functioning feedback loop between live agent performance and the engineering backlog.
* A 12-month roadmap for your function that leadership has signed up to.

**First 12 months**

* Measured, defensible business value delivered against pre-established baselines — reported honestly, including where the result fell short.
* Adoption at a level where the redesigned workflow is the normal way the work is done, not an optional tool.
* At least one reusable pattern contributed to the CoE and adopted by another function.
* A function that is materially more capable of absorbing the next wave than it was when you joined.

**How we assess**

* Portfolio conversation — a transformation or product initiative you owned end to end, including the value actually realised versus the value forecast.
* Written exercise — a short PRD or workflow redesign on a realistic problem from your function.
* Working session with the AI CoE on scoping and quality definition for a live QAD workflow.
* Stakeholder interview with leadership from the function you would cover.

 **Additional Information**  

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD:**

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist

In this role, you will:

This role focuses on developing and maintaining Java and Spring Boot APIs and microservices and the supporting services that keep them running. It sits across the end-to-end delivery and run lifecycle, spanning software development, testing and operational support. You’ll work across modern cloud environments and tooling while helping strengthen software delivery practices across the engineering community. The role also connects closely with product owners, agile coaches and partner engineering teams to ship changes smoothly and address issues early. Success means reliable services, cleaner releases, strong monitoring and practical improvements to how teams build, deploy and operate software.

What you'll be doing

* Develop and maintain APIs and microservices in Java and Spring Boot across supporting services (AWS/PCF)
* Deliver software development, testing and operational support across the delivery and run lifecycle
* Improve the software delivery lifecycle through better design, maintenance and continuous improvement
* Partner with Ops, Dev and Test Engineers to identify and address operational issues across releases and changes
* Use monitoring and observability tooling such as Splunk, AppDynamics and Datadog to support service health
* Collaborate with engineers, architects, agile coaches and stakeholders to shape and evolve software products
* Contribute to the Engineering Discipline and associated communities to share practices and standards
* Advocate modern software development practices aligned to cyber security and regulations including data privacy, consent and data residency

What we're looking for

* Bring strong Java, Spring Boot, API and microservices development experience
* Apply cloud and container platform knowledge across AWS, Kubernetes and Docker
* Use engineering tools including Git, Jenkins, Pivotal Cloud, Jira, Confluence and debugging toolsets
* Apply monitoring expertise with tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics and Datadog
* Use standard testing and performance tools such as JMeter and Postman for APIs
* Demonstrate hands-on application security, memory management, threading and code quality practices
* Show experience building engineering culture in agile and DevOps environments including deployment and operation
* Influence stakeholders using clear reasoning and evidence-based recommendations
* Building reliable API services

If you want to build Java and Spring Boot services that are easier to ship and easier to run this role gives you end-to-end scope to do both. You’ll help teams release with fewer surprises by strengthening delivery practices and addressing operational concerns early. The work spans modern tooling, observability and practical engineering standards that improve quality across products. If shaping how software is built and operated across an engineering community sounds like the right next step we’d like to hear from you

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

title: Architect Manager, Data & AI (GenAI) — Tax Automations & Innovation
description:
**About the Team**
------------------

The Tax Technology Automations & Innovation team — known internally as the AI Team — builds the automations, Generative AI, and internal tooling that let DoorDash's global Tax function scale as the business grows across the US, Canada, and — through Wolt and Deliveroo — internationally. We turn manual, repetitive tax work into reliable, governed software, and we bring modern AI into the heart of how a tax function operates — responsibly, and with auditability built in. The team is organised into an AI Strategy function and three regional pillars: EMEA, US & Canada, and Coffee & Special Projects.

This role sits in the AI Strategy function and reports to the Tax Technology lead. You will set the technical and AI direction the three regional pillars build around, and partner across Tax, Tax Tech, Data Operations, Accounting, Product, and Engineering, as well as InfoSec, Internal Audit, and Compliance.

**About the Role**
------------------

DoorDash is looking for a senior-level AI and data expert to lead how the Tax department operates through automation, Generative AI, and intelligent data tooling. Beyond building high-impact automation, you will set the strategy for how LLMs, GenAI, and machine learning are integrated into critical tax workflows at scale, and act as the AI authority for the function.

This is the role that makes the entire team AI-native rather than merely AI-assisted. By owning the AI and automation governance framework, you will also ensure that everything the team builds on top of sensitive tax data stays controlled, defensible, and audit-ready. You don't just build — you set the bar, mentor the regional teams, and decide how we adopt a fast-moving technology responsibly.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Define and lead the GenAI strategy for the Tax function, identifying high-value use cases and setting adoption standards.
* Architect and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions — intelligent assistants, AI-driven classification, anomaly detection, automated audit support, document summarization, and retrieval-augmented reporting.
* Own the AI and automation governance framework — model risk, change control, testing and validation standards, documentation, and auditability for tools that touch tax data and filings.
* Set the rules for responsible, controlled AI use, including data privacy, data residency, and what data may be sent to external model providers, partnering with InfoSec, Internal Audit, and Compliance.
* Partner with senior Tax, Product, and Engineering leaders to drive requirements and deliver measurable business impact.
* Mentor the Senior Analysts and Associate Managers across all regional pillars on applying GenAI/LLMs effectively and within governance guardrails.
* Quantify, track, and communicate the business impact of AI solutions (efficiency gains, error reduction, compliance risk mitigation).

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* You have 8+ years of hands-on experience in AI, GenAI, and data automation, delivering production-grade solutions at scale.
* You have deep expertise in LLMs and GenAI techniques — prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, evaluation frameworks, conversational AI, classification, and summarization.
* You are advanced in Python and SQL and have built scalable AI and automation pipelines.
* You have a strong background in automation and applied analytics, ideally in tax, finance, or regulated industries.
* You have deployed AI in cloud data environments such as Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, or Databricks.
* You have expertise in AI governance, compliance, and risk management for regulated environments.
* You can translate complex AI capabilities into intuitive tools for non-technical users, and influence at all levels from hands-on teams to executives.
* You have a Bachelor's degree or higher.
* You have (preferably) knowledge of tax technology platforms or experience with global tax teams
* You have (preferably) experience in a high-growth technology, marketplace, or e-commerce company.

**About DoorDash**
==================

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
=============================================

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Technical Engineering Manager_Core AI
description:
As an AI Engineering Manager on our Core AI team in India, you will be a cornerstone of FloQast's AI transformation and a key leader in our growing global engineering organization. You will manage and scale a team of high-performing software and AI engineers responsible for architecting and deploying production AI systems—powering our accounting automation platform and bringing our vision of an AI accountant teammate to life.

This role requires a balance between people leadership, operational excellence, and technical leadership in modern AI paradigms. You will partner with global engineering leadership, product management, and architecture teams to establish technical standards for agentic workflows, model context protocols (MCP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and LLMOps across FloQast. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will play a critical role in expanding FloQast’s AI footprint by recruiting, mentoring, and developing top-tier engineering talent in India.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* **Team Leadership & Development:** Lead, manage, mentor, and develop teams of AI software engineers. Grow your team members’ career paths through consistent coaching, performance management, and continuous feedback.
* **AI Technical Direction & Delivery:** Guide your team in the architecture and delivery of scalable production AI products, including intelligent chatbots, document processing systems, and agentic workflows using Python and modern AI frameworks.
* **Recruiting & Site Growth:** Actively recruit, interview, and retain top-tier AI engineering talent to build out FloQast's Core AI capabilities in India.
* **Global Collaboration:** Collaborate effectively with product managers, QA, architecture, security, and global engineering leaders to design and implement our centralized AI platform (model routing, provider management, vector search).
* **Process & Culture:** Cultivate an engineering culture of innovative, egoless, high-trust problem solving. Champion lean software development, Agile principles, and robust LLMOps/DevOps practices for AI systems.
* **Production Excellence:** Ensure your team builds robust, compliant, and observable AI products that integrate seamlessly with diverse technologies (accounting systems, external APIs) in a B2B SaaS environment.

### **What You'll Bring**

* **5+ years of software engineering management experience,** with a track record of leading teams to deliver complex backend or AI products to a paying customer base.
* **5+ years of experience as an individual contributor** as a software engineer, with a strong background in Python, backend development, and cloud-native environments (AWS preferred).
* **Production AI Experience:** Familiarity with LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), conversational AI, and scalable system design for AI products.
* **Distributed Team Leadership:** Proven experience leading and managing teams that are geographically distributed, driving alignment across time zones.
* **Recruiting & Mentorship:** Hands-on experience recruiting and interviewing engineering personnel, alongside a strong track record of managing individuals' performance and career growth.
* **Agile & Delivery Mastery:** 5+ years working on teams using Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) with a strong commitment to automated testing, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* **Communication & Alignment:** Strong ability to communicate complex system designs and AI strategies to both technical and business stakeholders.

### **Nice To Haves**

* Experience managing managers of software engineering teams.
* Hands-on experience with advanced RAG architectures, reranking systems, semantic search systems, or AI observability/monitoring tools.
* Experience working on B2B SaaS products, particularly in the financial or accounting space.
* Familiarity with our broader web stack (MongoDB, Express, React, and Node) to facilitate seamless integration between AI services and core applications.
* Knowledge of model context protocols (MCP) or reinforcement learning techniques (RLHF).

FloQast is the leading AI-powered Accounting Transformation Platform, uniquely built by former accountants for accountants. We automate complex, recurring accounting workflows—transforming preparers into strategic reviewers and relieving accountants from tedious manual work. Our cloud-based solution is trusted by over 3,500 world-class accounting teams, including Lululemon, Doordash, and the MLB, to drive collaboration and financial accuracy. Driven by a mission to continuously elevate the profession, FloQast is redefining both the practice and the perception of accounting on a global scale.

title: Application Support Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Overview**

The **L2 Application Support Engineer** (Technical Support Analyst) is a critical role within the Production Support and Operations team. This individual is responsible for providing high-quality technical support, troubleshooting, and incident resolution for complex enterprise applications and platforms. Acting as the bridge between L1 Helpdesk/Monitoring teams and L3 Development/Engineering groups, the L2 Engineer ensures system availability, stability, and adherence to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) in a fast-paced, enterprise technology environment.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Incident & Problem Management**

* **Escalation Handling:** Acknowledge and own incidents escalated by the L1 support team or monitoring alerts.
* **Troubleshooting & Diagnosis:** Perform in-depth technical analysis and root cause investigation of application, database, middleware, and infrastructure failures.
* **Workaround Implementation:** Apply approved temporary workarounds or permanent hotfixes to restore services quickly and minimize business impact.
* **Collaboration:** Partner with L3 developers, database administrators (DBAs), network engineers, and system administrators to resolve complex, multi-tiered issues.
* **Incident Lifecycle Management:** Track and document all incident progression within the ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow) from creation through to resolution.
  

  

**2. Monitoring, Observability & Preventive Maintenance**

* **System Monitoring:** Actively monitor application health, batch jobs, integration feeds, and system performance using enterprise observability suites.
* **Proactive Interventions:** Identify recurring patterns, error trends, or capacity bottlenecks and initiate preventative actions.
* **Health Checks:** Perform daily health checks, start-of-day (SOD) and end-of-day (EOD) verifications, and batch processing runs.

**3. Release, Deployment & Configuration Management**

* **Deployment Validation:** Support the verification of application deployments, system patches, and infrastructure upgrades during maintenance windows.
* **Configuration Controls:** Maintain and update application configuration files, environment variables, and parameter settings under strict change management processes.
* **Environment Management:** Assist in maintaining non-production (UAT/Staging) and production environments to ensure consistency.

**4. Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* **Status Updates:** Provide clear, timely, and precise communications to business stakeholders, product owners, and technology leadership during critical (Sev-1/Sev-2) incidents.
* **Bridges & War Rooms:** Participate in or lead technical incident bridges to coordinate restoration efforts.
* **Post-Incident Reviews:** Contribute technical inputs to Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation.

**5. Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* **Runbooks & SOPs:** Document and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), application architecture maps, and troubleshooting runbooks.
* **Knowledge Sharing:** Train L1 teams on common issue resolution paths to shift-left workloads and improve first-contact resolution rates.

**Qualifications & Experience**

  
  

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* **Experience:** 8+ years of experience in an application support, technical support, or systems engineering role (preferably in an enterprise or financial services environment).
* **Certifications (Desirable):**
  + ITIL v3 or v4 Foundation certification.
  + Professional certifications in AWS/Azure, Kubernetes (CKAD), Linux Administration, or Oracle/SQL.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Domain**

title: Emulation Verification Engineer (AI)
description:
**Description**

  
  

**Invent the future with us.**

  
  
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.  
  
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.  
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!

**About the role:**

As a part of the Emulation Team at Ampere, you will be part of verification of the next generation of microprocessor cores on hardware emulation platform by developing and deploying new capabilities and test content to accelerate bug finding in pre-silicon.

**What you'll achieve:**

Your responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Be part of the emulation verification execution team and be responsible for planning, development, and execution of test content in varied domains including system stress, cache coherency and concurrency.
* Work in collaboration with design and architecture teams to root-cause failures using advanced debugging techniques.
* Create emulation models from RTL to run test content, using industry standard emulation platform technology.
* Develop or integrate high performance transactors and emulation test bench in System Verilog, System C/C++ and Python

**About you:**

* M. Tech or B. Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 2+ years of semiconductor experience
* Good understanding of Soc architecture and System Verilog for design and verification.
* Strong software development experience in compiled (C/C++) and interpreted (Python, Tcl) languages
* Strong hardware/software co-debug skills.
* Knowledge about Cache coherency models, memory consistency models in AArch64 and/or x86.
* Knowledge about coherent interconnect protocols such as AMBA CHI, AXI4, ACE, etc. Knowledge of PCIE, Ethernet, DDR/LPDDR technology is a plus.
* Experience developing bare-metal content using C/C++ and assembly language for verification. ARM assembly expertise preferred.
* Emulation technology of Zebu, Palladium or Mentor Veloce or FPGA Prototyping would be preferred.
* Self-motivated engineer with passion for innovation and demonstrated out-of-box thinking is strongly required.

  
  
  

**What we’ll offer:**

  
At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

  
And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.  
  
Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

**Why This Role? Why Now?**

Customer experience is transforming through AI-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we don’t just embrace this change; we lead it. **Mission**

As the AI Services Manager at Zendesk, you will be leading a team by example with product expertise, and joining a management team in our expanding AI Delivery team.Your mission is to provide technical solutions and remove roadblocks for your customers to drive resolutions on our AI Platform. Your strong consulting skills and project management expertise will ensure **seamless integration and optimisation of AI solutions** , driving transformative business outcomes.

  

**Overarching Objective For The Role**

Build and lead the new AI Delivery team. Stand up the team, methodology and ways of working, while staying hands-on in customer delivery.  

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **Continuous Learning:** Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends and advancements, ensuring the delivery of cutting-edge solutions to clients.

  

**Qualifications**

* Must have a minimum of 8+ years of related experience in Consulting / Professional Services.

* **Strong hands-on experience working with API integration, specifically REST APIs, with a solid understanding of JSON and SQL scripting.**
* **End-to-end team handling experience, including conducting performance evaluations, creating growth plans, and assigning tasks.**
* Demonstrated experience in using adoption and health analytics to build predictive models and forecasts for churn and expansion; surface early risk signals and recommend mitigations to secure retention and growth.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing success plans or roadmaps that drive measurable customer outcomes.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees; certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
* Experience managing AI or software adoption programs with demonstrated impact on business metrics such as retention or satisfaction.
* Certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.

Ability to distill complex AI concepts for diverse audiences, especially executive stakeholders.

**Join Date**

The ideal candidate should be able to join within **one month** of the offer acceptance.
