You will be part of a forward-thinking team at the forefront of digital innovation in the Indian banking sector. We offer a challenging and rewarding environment where your work will have a direct impact on millions of customers and our bank's strategic growth.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

References
  
  
Visible links
  
1. https://www.bain.com/about/awards-recognition/
  
2. https://www.bain.com/careers/work-with-us/integrated-teams/ai-insights-solutions-ais/

title: Specialist - Experience Platform & Integrations
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

**The Role**
------------

As the Specialist - Experience Platform & Integrations, you will drive the administration, governance, and technical evolution of our core enterprise feedback systems (currently Qualtrics). Being part of the “System Owner” team you will have to blend robust technical aptitude with foundational project management skills, in order to safeguard the platform's integrity while architecting extensions into broader data ecosystems.

This role bridges the gap between operations (running the existing Qualtrics setup) and IT (extending the functionality by analyzing, developing and deploying new integrations) combining daily system administration and stakeholder enablement with advanced survey architecture and insightful reporting**.**

**Primary Mandate:** Serve as a core member of the system owners team, governing the full portfolio of customer satisfaction projects, core metrics, and our evolving suite of analytics tools.

**Broader Impact:** Embrace secondary opportunities to showcase your technical skills and forward-thinking mindset by contributing to broader technology projects within Customer Service beyond the core survey platform

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Survey management:** Create, configure, and maintain surveys, forms, and questionnaires.
* **User administration:** Create/manage user accounts, roles, permissions, and access, across CX and EX platforms.
* **Workflows:** Set up automated workflows, notifications, and actions based on survey responses. Monitor and maintain workflows connected to HRIS and EX automation triggers connected to Employee lifecycle events.
* **Data management:** Monitor survey data, Imports, exports, integrations, and data quality.
* **Troubleshooting:** Resolve issues related to surveys, permissions, workflows, and platform functionality.
* **Governance:** Ensure proper usage, security, access controls, and data privacy.
* **Support:** Help HR, CX, EX, or other business teams use Qualtrics effectively.
* Demonstrate tech-stack flexibility and open-mindedness about the existing tech stack, with a clear readiness to transition away from Qualtrics to alternative platforms if business needs dictate a change.
* Act as a trusted advisor to operations, providing best-practice guidance and suggestions on survey design rather than acting as a passive order-taker.
* Own the integration roadmap for the platform, architecting and overseeing seamless data connections between the survey system, current enterprise applications, and future tech stack expansions.
* Drive end-to-end integration strategy, bridging the feedback platform with existing and future enterprise systems to create a unified data ecosystem.
* Be able to expand platform extensibility by designing and possibly introducing new databases or data lake entities, ensuring enterprise repositories are enriched with Customer Experience (CX) or Employee Experience (EX) data for future connections.

**Technical & System Requirements**
-----------------------------------

* **Platform Expertise:** 4+ years of hands-on administration, governance, and advanced survey architecture experience in Qualtrics (CoreXM, CX, EX). Certification (e.g., Qualtrics CX/EX Expert) is highly preferred.
* **Integrations & APIs:** Proven experience building and managing APIs, webhooks, ETL pipelines to connect feedback platforms with enterprise ecosystems (CRMs like Salesforce/Zendesk, HRIS like Workday/SuccessFactors, and BI tools).
* **Data Engineering & Analytics:** Proficiency in SQL and database design. Experience designing data lake entities, data models, or staging tables (AWS, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Azure) to merge CX/EX data with core operational databases.
* **Scripting & Customization:** Functional knowledge of JavaScript, HTML/CSS for advanced survey customization, embedded data manipulation, and dynamic display logic.
* **Platform Flexibility:** Hands-on familiarity or willingness to transition to alternative Experience Management (XM) platforms (e.g., Medallia, Sprinklr, QuestionPro) if strategic needs shift**.**

**Functional & Governance Requirements**
----------------------------------------

* **Lifecycle & Workflow Automation:** Track record of setting up automated HRIS-triggered employee lifecycle workflows (onboarding, exit, pulse) and closed-loop CX actioning workflows.
* **Data Privacy & Governance:** Strong understanding of global and local data protection regulations (GDPR, India's DPDP Act) to enforce role-based access control (RBAC), data masking, and secure data handling.
* **Consultative Survey Design:** Ability to advise cross-functional teams (HR, Customer Service, Product) on survey methodology, scale design, bias reduction, and metric selection (NPS, CSAT, CES, eNPS).

**Professional Experience & Education**
---------------------------------------

* **Work Experience:** Prior experience in System Ownership, Experience Management (CX/EX), Product Operations, or Enterprise Software Administration**.**
* **Industry Context:** Prior experience in high-volume, tech-first environments like Global Capability Centers (GCCs), IT/ITeS, e-commerce, travel tech, or SaaS organizations in India.
* **Educational Qualification:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.

**Soft Skills & Project Management**
------------------------------------

* **Stakeholder Management:** Excellent communication skills to act as a trusted advisor rather than an order-taker, pushing back constructively on inefficient requests.
* **Agile Project Management:** Experience handling an integration roadmap, prioritizing backlog items, and managing cross-departmental delivery timelines.
* **Problem-Solving & Adaptability:** Strong troubleshooting mindset for diagnosing broken workflows, data mismatches, and integration failures.

**Benefits**
------------

What’s in it for You?

* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** Confidential, free support for personal or work-related challenges—covering counseling, or financial guidance, and more—to help maintain well-being and performance.
* **Term Life Insurance:** Provides financial peace of mind for your loved ones with a fixed-coverage death benefit over a defined term. Affordable protection offered by your employer.
* **Mediclaim (Health Insurance):** Extensive coverage for medical expenses to ensure you and your family get the care you need when it matters.
* **Meal Coupons:** A tasty perk to fuel your workday—delicious meals or snacks on us!
* **Learning & Development (L&D) Sessions:** Continued growth through curated upskilling sessions—boosting your skills and career progression.

##### **Diversity disclaimer**

*At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds.* *During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.*

title: MDS AMEA Customer Experience Regional Lead
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.**

You are part of a team that experiments with cutting-edge technologies, delivering solutions revealed as a result of the testing and learnings, and developing strong partnerships to enable growth through innovation and agile methodologies.

**How you will contribute**

You will implement pilot projects to drive disruptive ideas across the organization, using the learnings from these projects to inform decisions on whether to incorporate them as a portfolio project or to introduce them as a new proof of concept. You will also get to experiment with cutting-edge technologies while at the same time building strong partnerships within the business to build a strong pipeline of ideas to pursue. In addition, you will get to bring the outside in by building relationships with start-ups and building your knowledge of actual proof-of-concept cases, and scope, align, adopt and leverage technology for respective learnings and pilots.

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

* Project management including knowledge of Agile
* Technical expertise and a passion for innovation, understanding a variety of disruptive technology products and services
* Technical and business acumen to evaluate opportunities with internal and external partners
* Machine learning/artificial intelligence programming languages
* The start-up landscape
* Familiarity with the fast-moving consumer goods or related sector
* Leading internal and external teams through complex challenges and developing creative solutions/options
* Driving for results and Analytical Skills

**More about this role**

**What you need to know about this position:**

This is a hands-on leadership role with a **Product mindset** — not a coordination or engagement function. The OTC Regional Success Manager is the **regional integrator** across all four OTC product areas, responsible for connecting strategy to execution and ensuring value delivery at scale.

The role holder acts as the single point of accountability at the regional level for:

* Synergizing business requirements across Business Units

* Maintaining real-time visibility on project portfolio and operations performance

* Driving digital adoption of OTC tools

* Holding Product Managers and Operations leaders accountable for outcomes

This role spans all four OTC product areas:

1. Order Capture - End-to-end order intake, validation, EDI/portal management

2. Order Fulfillment - Order processing, availability, delivery execution & monitoring

3. Bill to Cash - Invoicing, collections, cash application, dispute resolution

4. Customer Care - Customer query handling, issue resolution, service performance

**What extra ingredients you will bring:**

**Regional OTC Community of Practice & Governance**

* **Establish and sustain** a Regional OTC Community of Practice spanning all four product areas.

* Drive a **monthly governance cadence** with structured inputs/outputs that feed all downstream accountabilities.

* Ensure the Community of Practice serves as the activation engine for change adoption, best practice sharing, and regional alignment.

* Curate and escalate regional themes, pain points, and opportunities into global product and operations forums.

**Business Requirements Synergization & Gatekeeper Role**

* **Synergize and rationalize** OTC business requirements (BRDs) at regional level in partnership with OTC Product Business Analysts.

* Act as the **gatekeeper** to prevent BU-level fragmentation — blocking unauthorized customizations in the form of MEs, siloed projects, shadow IT, or ungoverned local builds.

* Ensure all regional requirements are aligned with the enterprise product roadmap and S4/HANA migration timelines.

* Provide a consolidated regional demand view to Global Product Managers for backlog prioritization.

**Project Portfolio Visibility & Accountability**

* **Own the OTC Project Portfolio view** — maintaining real-time visibility across MEs, ND Projects, and Celonis-linked value delivery initiatives.

* Connect the dots between **Funding, Cost, and Value Realization** — ensuring every investment has a measurable outcome.

* Hold Product Managers accountable for delivery gaps, timeline slippages, and value leakage.

* Provide executive-ready portfolio reporting (weekly/monthly) to the Global OTC Lead and regional stakeholders.

**BPO Operations Performance & Accountability**

* **Own the BPO Operations performance lens** — tracking Celonis KPIs across the regional operations footprint.

* Hold Operations Leaders and OTC Product Managers accountable for performance gaps against contracted SLAs and KPIs.

* Drive corrective action plans when performance deviates from targets — not just flagging, but fixing.

* Partner with BPO governance leads to ensure operational insights inform technology roadmap priorities.

**Digital Adoption & Value Realization**

* **Drive digital adoption** of OTC tools (Celonis, SAP, Non-SAP) by setting adoption targets and measuring usage.

* Leverage the Community of Practice as the primary channel for driving tool awareness, training, and behavioral change.

* Track adoption metrics at country level to identify laggards and deploy targeted interventions.

* Ensure adoption translates to measurable business value (not just login counts, but process improvement outcomes).

**Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in OTC/shared services operations, product management, or transformation leadership.

* 3+ years in a senior role (Senior Manager or Director) with cross-functional accountability.

* Proven track record of driving adoption and value realization across multiple stakeholder groups.

* Experience in OTC / Order Management / Finance shared services in a large CPG/FMCG or similar enterprise.

* Demonstrated ability to act as a gatekeeper — saying “no” to fragmentation while maintaining stakeholder relationships.

* Experience with process mining tools (Celonis preferred) and linking process insights to business outcomes.

* Familiarity with Agile product management frameworks and portfolio governance.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of OTC end-to-end processes: Order Capture, Fulfillment, Billing, Collections, Cash Application, Dispute Management, and Customer Care.

* Working knowledge of SAP ECC / S4HANA OTC modules (SD, FI-AR).

* Proficiency in Celonis — ability to interpret process mining data and translate into action.

* Familiarity with project portfolio management tools and dashboards.

* Data literacy — ability to connect cost, adoption, and value metrics into a coherent narrative.

* Financial acumen — understanding of funding models, cost allocation, and value realization tracking.

**Leadership & Soft Skills**

* **Assertive accountability** — ability to hold peers and senior stakeholders accountable without direct authority.

* **Integrator mindset** — connecting dots across products, projects, operations, and adoption.

* **Executive communication** — ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable insights.

* **Influence without authority** — driving outcomes through governance, data, and relationships.

* Strong stakeholder management across Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and Commercial functions.

* Data-driven decision making — leveraging analytics for prioritization and accountability.
* Cultural sensitivity and ability to operate effectively across diverse regional contexts



Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy

**Business Unit Summary**
-------------------------

**Good to have skills :** Graph Databases, Data Engineering  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required

Summary:  

  

AI Powered Tech Talent  

Role Summary / Description  

Senior Engineer role in Knowledge Engineering focused on designing, building, and leading significant workstreams for enterprise\-scale Knowledge Graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI knowledge solutions on Microsoft Azure. In this role, the successful candidate leads a substantial knowledge engineering scope within a large program, translates real\-world business problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, guides technical direction, and contributes to thought leadership, reusable assets, and delivery standards. The role must bring relevant industry experience across domains such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, applying semantic AI, knowledge graphs, LLM grounding, data pipelines, and cloud\-native engineering patterns to deliver measurable client value.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

Engineer Azure\-based knowledge engineering solutions using services such as Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse/Fabric, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, APIs, and Azure Monitor.  

Build graph ingestion pipelines, semantic data products, vector integrations, LLM grounding layers, APIs, and governed access patterns on Azure while improving performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.  

Lead the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform client data architecture within a large program scope.  

Direct the design, development, and implementation of AI, semantic layer, ontology, taxonomy, schema, graph modeling, and knowledge curation solutions, ensuring all components work together seamlessly.  

Work with project leaders, delivery leads, client stakeholders, architects, data engineers, AI engineers, product teams, and domain SMEs to create standout graph\-powered data and AI offerings.  

Develop strong client relationships, earn trust as a key advisor, and explain the business value of semantic layer, ontology, and knowledge graph solutions.  

Make the business case for the recommended semantic layer solution and contribute meaningfully to sales, pre\-sales, estimation, proposal inputs, and solution shaping activities.  

Provide thought leadership on technology trends, innovation opportunities, limitations, risks, delivery concerns, and practical adoption of knowledge graphs, semantic AI, LLM grounding, RAG, and agentic systems.  

Design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, schemas, standards, and reusable engineering patterns, while guiding teams on data model quality and implementation methods.  

Lead a team or workstream within a larger program, mentor engineers, review design/code/configuration, and guide adoption of new methodologies, model building techniques, and algorithms.  

Collaborate across business and technical teams to drive end\-to\-end delivery for the assigned scope and demonstrate value to business and technology stakeholders.  

  

Required Qualifications  

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.  

Minimum 3 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, graph query languages, schema design, ontology management, and KG curation.  

Minimum 3 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation.  

Minimum 3 years of experience designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph\-based ML models across functional and technical workstreams.  

Minimum 2 years of experience implementing end\-to\-end data pipelines for AI applications, especially LLM\-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands\-on design and configuration.  

Minimum 4 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases.  

Minimum 2 years of experience leading a team or workstream within a larger program.  

Experience collaborating with engineering, research, product, domain, client\-facing, and cross\-functional teams across multiple time zones.  

  

Required Skills/ Experience  

Hands\-on experience building Azure\-based knowledge engineering solutions with Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse/Fabric, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, APIs, and Azure Monitor.  

Strong Python experience with frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, PySpark, SQL, SPARQL, SHACL, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, and ETL/ELT pipeline tooling.  

Practical knowledge of NLP and search techniques including entity extraction, entity resolution, semantic search, prompt engineering, LLM grounding, and enterprise\-scale LLM applications.

Strong collaboration, technical leadership, delivery ownership, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.  

  

Good to Have Skills  

2\+ years of hands\-on experience with cloud platforms, with Azure specialization and exposure to AWS or GCP in multi\-cloud environments.  

Azure certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Data Engineer, Azure AI Engineer, or related credentials.  

Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, including domain ontologies, data models, compliance needs, and knowledge\-driven use cases.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced AI Platform Engineer to bridge the gap between cutting\-edge generative AI application design and production\-grade cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate lives at the intersection of MLOps, DevOps, and Platform Engineering, with deep technical expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Terraform, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD. * GCP AI Ecosystem: Hands\-on experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder (or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform components like Agent Studio, Agent Development Kit (ADK), and Agent Engine).
* Advanced Terraform: Deep knowledge of writing reusable, modular Terraform code to manage complex cloud environments, IAM policies, and managed services.
* CI/CD Expertise: Proven track record of configuring complex GitLab pipelines, utilizing runners, environment staging, caching, and automated testing blocks.
* Core GCP Architecture: Solid understanding of baseline GCP infrastructure, including GKE, Cloud Run, VPC/Shared VPC networking, Identity\-Aware Proxy (IAP), and Cloud Storage.
* Scripting \& Orchestration: Strong programming skills in Python (preferred for Agent ADK work) or Go.

**Core Technical Requirements**

* GCP AI Ecosystem: Hands\-on experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder (or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform components like Agent Studio, Agent Development Kit (ADK), and Agent Engine).
* Advanced Terraform: Deep knowledge of writing reusable, modular Terraform code to manage complex cloud environments, IAM policies, and managed services.

title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------


AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.  

  

As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.  

In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.**Your Impact**
---------------

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 14 \+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


Regional travel up to 35%.

title: Lead D&T Analyst – AI & Automation
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

The Digital and Technology (D\&T) India, is seeking a Lead Analyst, to join the AI and Automation team. The AIA Activation team serves as the bridge between identifying AI use cases to enabling value through business adoption. The AI \& Automation team is seeking a Lead AIA Analyst to shepherd General Mills’ AI journey into agent\-based (agentic) capabilities — planning, delivering, and governing our enterprise AI platforms, custom AI agents, and the processes that support them. This highly visible role will partner with business and D\&T stakeholders to identify and execute high‑value AI use cases, then create, manage, and sustain the expansion of generative and agent\-based capabilities across the enterprise, working closely with other D\&T AI initiatives to shape the overall AI user experience


**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Partner with functional domain stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize high\-value AI and agentic AI use cases.
* Lead discovery and opportunity assessment efforts to determine where AI can improve decision\-making, process efficiency, service levels, productivity, and user experience.
* Translate business problems into clear analytical, technical, and delivery requirements for AI solutions, agents, and supporting workflows.
* Lead planning and implementation of AI and automation initiatives, including pilots, proofs of value, and scaled deployments.
* Collaborate with business teams, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and platform partners to design and deliver Supply Chain AI capabilities.
* Support development of domain\-specific agents and workflows that augment functional domain processes and enable better human decision\-making.
* Evaluate existing functional domain processes, data, and pain points to determine where agentic AI can be responsibly and effectively applied.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders to educate teams on AI possibilities, assess readiness, and define business value.
* Help establish and sustain governance processes for functional domain AI use cases, including risk management, user acceptance, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure activation work follows established responsible AI, governance, risk, and documentation practices in partnership with the relevant teams.
* Contribute to development of best practices, playbooks, enablement assets, KPIs, and operating processes that strengthen activation capabilities across the Agentic AI office.
* Translate the learnings from the engagement to reusable consumable form for other areas to benefit from it.
* Support the intake, build, publish of the agents are in accordance to the defined frameworks by the AI Office.
* Monitor solution performance, user feedback, and business outcomes, then make recommendations for optimization and broader adoption.
* Analyze, present, and report on key performance indicators, value realization, and overall initiative progress to business and D\&T leaders.
* Partner to evaluate the technological releases including platform, services, models etc. within the Agentic AI space and document the recommendations.
* Work closely with the vendor partners as required to influence the prioritization of required features / fixes.
* Monitor feedback and insights, collaborating with Agent Authors to assess program effectiveness and make recommendations for optimization and improvement.
* Manage the agent publishing lifecycle, including user acceptance testing and acting as the first line of triage for agents.
* Monitor adoption, usage, performance, and user feedback for deployed capabilities, and help drive iterations that improve business impact and user experience over time.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, practical learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's in technology /engineering/science in a related field is required.
* Minimum years of related experience required: 2\+ years in AI, analytics, automation, digital product activation, data science, or related technical delivery roles, including experience leading projects or small teams.
* Overall industry experience: 10\+ years preferred Total analytics experience required 5\-6 Years.
* Experience activating AI, automation, analytics, or digital capabilities from pilot or proof of concept into business adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with stakeholders to define business problems, translate needs into delivery plans, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to explain AI concepts, rollout implications, and recommendations to non\-technical audiences.
* Working knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI practices, documentation expectations, and production monitoring disciplines.
* Ability to operate effectively in an environment with global partners and cross\-functional D\&T teams.
* Technical Skillset \- AI / Automation Activation, Adoption \& Change Management, Use Case Framing / Business Translation, KPI Tracking / Value Realization.
* Responsible for AI, Security, Governance, Process Design, Workflow Mapping, Visualization / Storytelling, Agile Delivery / Backlog Management, Data Intuition, Analytics, Cloud Platform literacy.

* Helps manage team backlog and delivery priorities.
* Supports creation and management of feature or activation roadmaps with manager guidance .
* Demonstrates learning agility and applies new ideas to improve work .
* Adopts and scales practical innovations that improve AI activation and business adoption.
* Contributes to playbooks, standards, and ways of working across the activation community.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Preferred Major Area of Study: Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience with GenAI and LLM\-enabled workflows is preferred.

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

* Collaborate with AI engineers and domain experts to deliver scalable, production\-ready vision solutions.

**Research \& Innovation*** Evaluate latest Computer Vision research.
* Experiment with emerging vision foundation models.
* Prototype innovative AI solutions.

**Required Technical Skills*** Strong programming skills in Python with experience in AI/ML development.
* Hands\-on experience with Deep Learning and Computer Vision frameworks.
* Experience developing solutions for Object Detection, Image Classification, Segmentation, OCR, Video Analytics, and Visual Inspection.
* Experience with modern Computer Vision architectures, including CNNs, Vision Transformers, and Foundation Vision Models.
* Strong understanding of image and video data processing, model training, evaluation, and optimization.
* Experience preparing and improving datasets through annotation, augmentation, and quality validation.
* Familiarity with GPU\-based model training and inference optimization.
* Working knowledge of Vision\-Language Models (VLMs) and Multimodal AI is preferred.
* Experience integrating AI models into production applications and collaborating with software engineering teams

**Preferred Experience*** 4–8 years of Computer Vision experience.
* Experience deploying production AI solutions.
* Experience training custom deep learning models.
* Experience with GPU optimization.
* Experience handling large\-scale image/video datasets.
* Experience working in Agile product teams.

**Soft Skills:**Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, excellent communication and collaboration, ownership mindset, adaptability, continuous learning, and a passion for innovation. ￼ **Why Join vConstruct?**
At vConstruct, you'll work on AI solutions that solve real\-world construction challenges at global scale. You'll collaborate with experts in AI, BIM, digital construction, and engineering to build cutting\-edge Computer Vision systems that shape the future of construction technology. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern vision foundation models, multimodal AI, and production\-grade machine learning while creating measurable impact across one of the world's largest industries **About vConstruct :**


vConstruct specializes in providing high quality Building Information Modeling and Construction Technology services geared towards construction projects. vConstruct is a wholly owned subsidiary of DPR Construction.

**Job Description: Senior Associate, Cyber Security Disputes \& Investigations**

**Overview**


Alvarez \& Marsal, a leading independent global professional services firm, specializing in providing turnaround management, performance improvement, and corporate advisory services, is seeking to expand its Disputes \& Investigations team. With more than 7,000 professionals based in 75\+ locations across 30\+ countries in North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America, our firm excels in problem\-solving and value creation. Drawing on a strong operational heritage and hands\-on approach, our professionals work closely with organizations and stakeholders to help tackle complex business issues and maximize value.

**The Position**


As a **Senior Associate** within A\&M's Cybersecurity practice in the Disputes \& Investigations group, you will play a key role in delivering cybersecurity, privacy, risk, and AI governance engagements across diverse industries. You will work directly with clients to assess cybersecurity posture, identify risks, develop remediation roadmaps, and support implementation of security and governance frameworks.


The successful candidate will contribute to and independently execute engagements involving:

**Cybersecurity Program Maturity Assessments**

* Evaluate cybersecurity programs against industry frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, COBIT, and other regulatory requirements.
* Assess governance structures, security operating models, policies, standards, and controls.
* Develop maturity assessments, gap analyses, and improvement roadmaps.

**IT Risk \& Security Assessments**

* Lead cybersecurity risk assessments across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, and third\-party ecosystems.
* Perform security reviews, data classification exercises, and control effectiveness assessments.
* Identify cybersecurity risks and provide practical mitigation recommendations.

**Data Privacy \& Regulatory Compliance**

* Conduct privacy assessments against DPDPA, GDPR, ISO 27701, and other applicable regulations.
* Support development and implementation of privacy governance frameworks, policies, and operating procedures.
* Assist clients in privacy program enhancement, data lifecycle reviews, and compliance readiness initiatives.

**AI Security \& Governance**

* Assess AI systems for security, privacy, governance, and compliance risks.
* Support implementation of AI governance frameworks, risk management practices, and responsible AI controls.
* Evaluate controls related to GenAI solutions, model governance, data protection, and regulatory requirements.

**Security Awareness \& Cyber Culture**

* Design and deliver cybersecurity and privacy awareness initiatives.
* Develop training content, phishing simulation programs, and executive awareness sessions.
* Support clients in building sustainable cyber risk awareness programs.

**Cybersecurity Architecture \& Technical Reviews**

* Participate in security assessments across cloud, infrastructure, application security, identity and access management, and data security domains.
* Review technical controls and architectures against security best practices and industry standards.
* Identify gaps and recommend improvements aligned to organizational risk appetite.

**Research \& Thought Leadership**

* Monitor emerging cybersecurity threats, industry trends, AI security developments, and evolving regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to thought leadership, methodologies, accelerators, and market\-facing content.

 **Role and Responsibilities**

**Client Delivery**

* Independently execute cybersecurity, privacy, and governance engagements with minimal supervision.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, control assessments, and documentation reviews.
* Analyze findings, prioritize risks, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Prepare high\-quality client reports, presentations, and executive briefings.

**Project Management**

* Manage workstreams and deliverables while ensuring quality and adherence to timelines.
* Coordinate with client stakeholders and internal teams to drive project execution.
* Support proposal development, scoping activities, and business development efforts.

**Team Leadership \& Collaboration**

* Mentor Analysts and Associates through technical guidance and quality reviews.
* Foster collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.
* Contribute to capability building, knowledge sharing, and practice development initiatives.

**Business Development Support**

* Contribute to proposal preparation, market research, and solution development.
* Participate in client meetings, workshops, and networking activities.

**Continuous Learning**

* Stay current on cybersecurity, AI governance, privacy regulations, and industry best practices.
* Pursue relevant professional certifications and technical skill development.

 **The Requirements**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 4\-6 years of relevant cybersecurity consulting, risk advisory, or information security experience.
* Experience delivering cybersecurity assessments, governance reviews, privacy initiatives, or compliance programs.

title: Credit Review Intermediate Analyst, Office (Hybrid)
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**About Credit Risk Review (CRR)**
==================================


**Credit Risk Review** (CRR) provides independent, objective, reliable, valued, and timely assurance to the Board of Directors, Risk Committees, the Citigroup Chief Risk Officer, the Citigroup Chief Credit Officer, senior management, and global regulators. CRR evaluates the effectiveness of credit and collateral risk management, assessing the ability of business units and independent Risk Management to identify, monitor, and mitigate current and emerging credit risks.


**Role Overview**
=================


As a key member of the **CRR Analytics Team**, you will provide critical data analytics and credit risk analyst support to Lead Reviewers. This role is instrumental in managing ongoing portfolio monitoring and credit reviews, identifying thematic risk trends, and evaluating emerging risks. You will collaborate closely with reviewers to assign portfolios, establish sample coverages, and participate actively in review activities, while also supporting broader data\-driven credit risk projects across the CRR group.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


* **Credit \& Exposure Assessment**: Evaluate the integrity and accuracy of credit analyses, exposure calculations, risk rating methodologies, and asset classifications for monitored and reviewed relationships to ensure alignment with institutional policies and standards.
* **Credit Assessment Documentation**: Partner with Lead Reviewers to draft comprehensive Credit Assessment Documents, integrating advanced credit and data analytics to quantify thematic risks or substantiate a portfolio's stable outlook ("good bill of health").
* **Assistant to the Lead Reviewer:** Serve as a strategic analytical partner to Lead Reviewers, translating qualitative observations and risk hypotheses into rigorous, data\-backed evidence. Maintain a deep understanding of credit policies and data structures to track the end\-to\-end credit lifecycle, including origination, underwriting standards, limit utilization, covenant compliance, and workout/remediation processes.
* **AI \& Analytics Innovation**: Leverage advanced AI and machine learning tools to streamline data extraction, identify thematic trends across diverse portfolios, and proactively flag emerging risk indicators.
* **Stakeholder Communication**: Synthesize complex analytical findings and present clear, concise conclusions and recommendations to Lead Reviewers and senior risk management.
* **Reporting \& Regulatory Presentations:** Assist in preparing high\-quality presentations and reporting materials to support internal governance committees and regulatory examinations.

**Qualifications**
==================


* **Experience:** 1\-2 years of credit analysis or credit risk management experience within a global financial institution or banking environment.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Formal credit training or a deep understanding of financial accounting standards and credit analysis methodologies.
* **Corporate/FI Analysis:** Prior experience assessing the creditworthiness and financial strength of Corporates and Financial Institutions is highly advantageous.
* **Digital Literacy:** High proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and a strong aptitude for adopting AI\-enabled productivity and data analytics tools in compliance with organizational policies. Knowledge of Python is highly advantageous.
* **Professional Attributes:** Proactive, self\-motivated, and collaborative team player with a strong desire to learn and the ability to execute independently in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* **Execution Skills:** Exceptional organizational and time\-management skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to prioritize multiple deliverables.
* **Communication:** Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex risk concepts clearly and concisely to various levels of management.

**Education**
=============


* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BSc) in Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a related quantitative field.
* Advanced degree (MBA, MS in Finance) and/or professional certification (e.g., CFA, FRM, CPA) are a plus.

Risk Management

Data Owners are needed to drive data excellence through strategic ownership and technical innovation.


As a Data Owner Senior Associate within Consumer \& Community Banking \- Data \& Analytics team, you will be responsible for end\-to\-end enablement, publishing, and governance for all data created. You help define and document product data—business definitions, metadata, classifications, and quality expectations—so it is discoverable, understood, and fit for purpose. 	+ Finance team for duty, costing, and payment coordination
* Act as single point of contact for import\-related queries.

### **6\. Performance Monitoring \& Reporting**

* Track and report key KPIs such as:
	+ OTIF (On Time In Full) supply
	+ Inventory Days of Supply (DOS)
	+ Shipment lead time adherence
	+ Freight \& logistics cost
* Analyze variances and drive corrective actions.

* Identify and implement process improvements in import planning and logistics.
* Drive digitalization, automation, and system enhancements (SAP/APO/IBP or similar).
* Support supply chain transformation initiatives and integration of new products/business.

* MBA / PGDM in Supply Chain or Operations (preferred)

### **Experience**

* 4–8 years of experience in supply planning, import/export, or logistics
* Experience in B2B business, Food Ingredients, Pharma, or Chemicals industry preferred
* Hands\-on experience in managing international suppliers and import operations

### **Technical Skills**

* Working knowledge of SAP (MM / APO / IBP) or equivalent ERP systems
* Strong understanding of import regulations, customs clearance, and incoterms
* Advanced proficiency in Excel (planning and analysis)
* Blue Yonder supply planning experience will be preferred

### **Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* High attention to detail and execution excellence
* Ability to manage ambiguity and handle multiple priorities
* Effective stakeholder management and communication skills
* Proactive and solution\-oriented mindset

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Inventory Days / Working Capital

title: Partner Development Specialist, Data, Amazon Partner Organization
description:
Are you passionate about building a thriving partner ecosystem that helps customers unlock the full potential of their data? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced Data Partner Development Specialist (PDS) to join our India Amazon Partner Organization (APO) team. In this role, you will be the partner\-facing authority on AWS Data and Analytics services — including Amazon Redshift, Amazon Athena, Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, Amazon MSK and Amazon S3 Vectors — driving partner capability development, co\-sell execution, and go\-to\-market (GTM) scale across the India market.



As a Data PDS, you will work directly with consulting, technology, and ISV partners to build differentiated data practices and offerings on AWS. You will enable partners to solve complex customer data challenges — from petabyte\-scale data lakes and real\-time streaming pipelines to enterprise data warehouse modernization — and drive measurable customer outcomes through partner\-led and partner\-attached motions. You will collaborate with AWS account teams, specialist SAs, services leadership, and partner programs to accelerate partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline, increase partner attach rates, and shape the future of the AWS data partner ecosystem in India.



Key job responsibilities


* Serve as the primary partner development lead for AWS Data and Analytics services across consulting, technology, and ISV partners in India.
* Identify, recruit, and develop partners with strong data capabilities, enabling them to build scalable practices around AWS data lake, data warehouse, streaming, and analytics services.
* Drive partner\-sourced and partner\-attached pipeline by co\-developing GTM plans, joint value propositions, and co\-sell motions with priority partners.
* Enable partners through technical readiness programs — including workshops, bootcamps, proof\-of\-concept (PoC) frameworks, and certification drives — to deepen their AWS data competencies.
* Collaborate with AWS Specialist SAs, account teams, and services teams to identify customer opportunities where partner engagement accelerates time\-to\-launch and improves outcomes especially with the AI team.
* Develop and execute joint business plans with strategic data partners, tracking key metrics such as partner attach rate, launched ARR, and customer impact.
* Work with AWS Partner Programs (e.g., competency programs, funding mechanisms, AWS Marketplace) to help partners access the right development and GTM support levers.
* Provide partner and field feedback to AWS product teams to influence service roadmaps and drive feature adoption relevant to the India partner ecosystem.
* Support competitive positioning by equipping partners with differentiation narratives against on\-premises and third\-party analytics platforms.
* Deliver thought leadership through partner summits, blog posts, case studies, and community engagement to elevate the AWS data partner brand in India.

### **Basic Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of Go\-To\-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
* 10\+ years of experience in partner development, business development, alliance management, or channel sales in the technology/cloud industry.
* Demonstrated experience building and scaling partner practices or GTM motions in the data, analytics, or AI/ML domain.
* Strong understanding of data architectures — data lakes, data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming, and analytics platforms. Good understanding of how data is the foundation to an Agentic AI paradigm.
* Experience managing joint business plans, partner pipeline, and co\-sell execution with measurable revenue outcomes.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
* Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements

title: Data Center Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.  

Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:  

  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
* You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
* You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

  

A day in the life  

As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day\-to\-day work will include:  

* Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
* Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
* Work within a ticket\-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
* Work on rotational shift\-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
* Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
* This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences
  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS
  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

Work/Life Balance
  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  

Inclusive Team Culture
  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health \& safety guidelines
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)

title: R2R Sr. Manager
description:
**Company Description**  

The Senior Manager – GA is the cornerstone of close excellence and balance sheet integrity within their scope. The role ensures that every financial result is accurate, audit\-ready, and delivered with confidence—while building a capable, accountable, and continuously improving team.  

  

Role Purpose  

  

The Senior Manager – General Accounting is responsible for delivering accurate, compliant, and timely financial results for an assigned cluster of entities. The role ensures disciplined month\-end close execution, robust balance sheet governance, SOX\-compliant controls, and strong partnership with Controllers. This leader drives performance, uplifts process maturity, and develops a high\-performing accounting team that demonstrates accountability, transparency, and operational excellence.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

  

1\. Close Execution and Financial Accuracy  

* Own month\-end and quarter\-end close activities for assigned entities, ensuring First\-Time\-Right (FTR) outcomes.
* Review Trial Balance, validate account movements, and ensure accuracy of journals, accruals, and provisions.
* Ensure full adherence to close calendar, cut\-offs, and controller expectations, maintaining a zero\-surprise environment.
* Drive governance routines, including pre\-close reviews, WD discipline, and quality checkpoints.


2\. Balance Sheet Governance and Risk Management  

  

* Ensure 100% balance sheet reconciliation completeness, accuracy, and timely approvals.
* Identify aged items, risks, and exposures early, driving remediation through root\-cause elimination.
* Ensure documentation integrity and audit\-ready reconciliations aligned with global policy.


3\. Controls and Compliance  

  

* Enforce SOX controls, journal approval discipline, evidence standards, and documentation requirements.
* Ensure teams are audit\-ready at all times, supporting internal/external audits with transparency and zero repeat findings.
* Maintain compliance with IFRS/US GAAP, NIQ policies, and global control frameworks.


4\. Stakeholder Management  

  

* Act as the operational partner to Entity/Cluster Controllers, Close Managers, and Finance stakeholders.
* Provide clear, data\-driven progress updates, risk visibility, and solution\-oriented communication.
* Manage escalations proactively and professionally, ensuring confidence in financial outcomes.


5\. People Leadership and Capability Development  

  

* Lead a team of Team Leads, Assistant Managers, and Analysts, ensuring clarity of goals, accountability, and performance.
* Drive a performance\-based culture with coaching, documented feedback, and role clarity; address bottom talent proactively.
* Build technical, control, and problem\-solving capabilities within the team; support succession planning and retention.


6\. Continuous Improvement and Standardisation  

  

* Reduce rework, improve accuracy, and eliminate process failures through structured CI initiatives.
* Ensure full adoption of global SOPs, standard work practices, and documentation discipline.
* Contribute to simplification, cycle\-time reduction, and process efficiency enhancements.


7\. Digital, Automation, and Analytics Adoption  

  

* Ensure effective use of ERP, OneStream, dashboards, and governance tools across all BAU processes.
* Support automation and analytics use cases to strengthen controls and improve productivity.

Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


**About the Team**

At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative. Workday’s Agent Factory is our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows, including expense processing, hiring, and workforce scheduling. We partner with core engineering to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability for our global customer base.
**About the Role**

We are seeking a customer\-focused Support Engineer to drive incident resolution, root\-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimisation across Workday’s enterprise platform and autonomous AI agent workflows. In this high\-visibility role, you will analyze system metrics, debug cloud\-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, and manage critical customer escalations within strict SLAs. You will also partner directly with engineering and data science teams through feature iteration and optimisation. A key part of this role involves hands\-on AI evaluation: analysing LLM outputs, reviewing conversation logs, and digging into system traces to spot failure modes and translate those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.


Key Responsibilities


* Enterprise SaaS \& Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* Hands\-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* Technical Troubleshooting \& RCA: Assist in root\-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* Cloud \& LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* Incident \& Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high\-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on\-call rotations.
* Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high\-stakes escalations.
* Database \& Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* Documentation \& Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications (Required)**
-----------------------------------

Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.


Technical \& Diagnostic Skills:


* Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command\-line tools.

Cloud \& Monitoring Systems:


* Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.

AI \& LLM Exposure:


* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.

Triage \& Operations:


* Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.

Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post\-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer\-facing teams.
* Strong active problem\-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi\-tiered enterprise systems.
